new_roles.title: Quality Director
new_roles.description:
**Quality Director**
--------------------

Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control

Reports To: Executive Leadership

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: INOX SOLAR Manufacturing Facility

**Job** **Summary**
-------------------

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading and overseeing all quality assurance and quality control activities at INOX SOLAR USA. This position ensures that solar modules, manufacturing processes, raw materials, and finished products meet established quality standards, customer requirements, applicable regulatory requirements, and company specifications.

The Quality Director develops and implements quality management systems, drives continuous improvement initiatives, leads quality investigations, and partners with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to reduce defects, improve product reliability, and maintain consistent manufacturing performance.

**Essential** **Duties** **and** **Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------------------

### **1.** **Quality** **Leadership** **and** **Strategy**

* Develop and implement the company's overall quality strategy, objectives, policies, and procedures.
* Establish quality performance metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and departmental goals.
* Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, including inspectors, technicians, engineers, and supervisors.
* Establish accountability for quality performance across all manufacturing departments.
* Provide regular quality performance reports, trend analyses, and improvement recommendations to executive leadership.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

### **2.** **Quality** **Management** **Systems** **and** **Compliance**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with applicable ISO standards, customer specifications, industry requirements, and internal quality procedures.
* Maintain controlled quality documentation, inspection records, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
* Lead internal audits, support external audits, and coordinate corrective actions resulting from audit findings.
* Maintain appropriate records to support product traceability, quality investigations, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate quality certification activities and customer or third-party audits as applicable.

### **3.** **Solar** **Module** **Manufacturing** **Quality**

* Oversee quality throughout the solar module manufacturing process, from incoming materials to final product release.
* Establish and maintain inspection standards for incoming materials, in-process production, and finished solar modules.
* Monitor manufacturing quality at critical production stages, including cell handling, stringing, layup, lamination, framing, junction box installation, EL testing, final inspection, and packaging.
* Ensure effective implementation of electroluminescence (EL) testing, visual inspections, electrical performance testing, and other required quality verification activities.
* Investigate manufacturing defects, process deviations, nonconforming products, and recurring quality issues.
* Work with Production and Engineering to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish procedures for product identification, traceability, nonconforming material control, and final product release.

### **4.** **Quality** **Control** **and** **Performance** **Improvement**

* Establish and monitor quality KPIs, including defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap rates, rework, customer complaints, and corrective action closure.
* Analyze quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead root cause analysis using appropriate methodologies, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Implement corrective and preventive action processes to prevent recurrence of quality issues.
* Partner with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce variation, and minimize manufacturing losses.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

### **5.** **Supplier** **and** **Incoming** **Quality** **Management**

* Establish supplier quality standards and incoming material inspection requirements.
* Collaborate with Purchasing, Supply Chain, and Engineering to evaluate supplier quality performance.
* Lead supplier corrective action requests and investigations involving defective or nonconforming materials.
* Monitor supplier quality trends and recommend supplier improvement plans when necessary.
* Support supplier audits, qualification activities, and ongoing supplier performance reviews.

### **6.** **Customer** **Quality** **and** **Product** **Reliability**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for significant customer quality concerns and escalations.
* Oversee investigations into customer complaints, product defects, and warranty-related quality issues.
* Coordinate corrective action responses and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Prepare quality reports and technical documentation for customers and executive leadership.
* Collaborate with relevant departments to identify opportunities to improve product reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Support product testing, validation, and quality requirements associated with new products and manufacturing process changes.

### **7.** **Leadership** **and** **Team** **Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate Quality Department employees.
* Establish clear departmental responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Provide training on quality standards, inspection procedures, documentation, and problem-solving methods.
* Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, and resources to support production quality requirements.
* Collaborate with department leaders to address quality issues and strengthen cross-functional communication.
* Encourage employees to identify quality risks and take appropriate action to prevent defects.

### **8.** **Risk** **Management** **and** **Continuous** **Improvement**

* Identify and evaluate risks that could affect product quality, reliability, safety, or customer satisfaction.
* Implement preventive controls to reduce the likelihood of manufacturing defects and product failures.
* Review quality risks associated with new equipment, process changes, materials, and product designs.
* Support change management processes to ensure changes are properly reviewed, validated, documented, and approved.
* Monitor emerging quality concerns and recommend appropriate preventive measures.
* Ensure lessons learned from quality incidents are incorporated into manufacturing procedures and employee training.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field required.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or Business Administration preferred.

### **Experience**

* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality control, or manufacturing quality management.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing quality teams or departments.
* Experience in solar module manufacturing, photovoltaic production, electronics manufacturing, or a related manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining quality management systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits, root cause investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing customer quality concerns, supplier quality issues, and manufacturing process improvements.

### **Technical** **Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ISO 9001 requirements.
* Familiarity with applicable photovoltaic module standards, such as IEC 61215 and IEC 61730, as relevant to the company's products and markets.
* Knowledge of manufacturing inspection methods, product testing, defect analysis, and quality documentation.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA, FMEA, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality reporting or manufacturing data systems.
* Ability to analyze complex quality data and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.

**Core** **Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strategic leadership and decision-making
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Effective communication and presentation skills
* Employee development and team management
* Risk assessment and corrective action management
* Continuous improvement and process optimization
* Customer focus and accountability

**Performance** **Measures** **(KPIs)**
---------------------------------------

The Director of Quality will be evaluated based on performance against established departmental and company goals, including:

* First-pass yield and overall production yield
* Manufacturing defect and nonconformance rates
* Scrap and rework reduction
* Customer complaints and warranty-related quality trends
* Corrective and preventive action closure rates
* Supplier defect rates and supplier corrective action performance
* Internal and external audit results
* Quality documentation accuracy and compliance
* Employee training completion and team performance
* Progress toward continuous improvement and product reliability goals

**Working** **Conditions**
--------------------------

* Work is performed in both an office and manufacturing environment.
* Regular presence on the production floor is required to monitor quality performance and support investigations.
* Must be able to work collaboratively with production personnel, engineers, technicians, suppliers, customers, and executive leadership.
* May require occasional extended hours or schedule flexibility to address significant quality issues, production concerns, audits, or customer escalations.
* Must comply with applicable company safety policies and manufacturing facility requirements.

**Equal** **Employment** **Opportunity**
----------------------------------------

INOX SOLAR is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

new_roles.title: Director of Sourcing & Production
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

Ethos Brands is seeking an experienced Director of Sourcing & Production to lead global sourcing, manufacturing, and production operations across its apparel businesses.

This role is responsible for developing and executing the sourcing and production strategy for all brands, ensuring products are manufactured to the highest standards of quality, cost, and delivery. The Director will oversee the end-to-end production process, from sourcing and vendor selection through costing, production execution, quality assurance, and final delivery to the distribution center.

As the central leader of the sourcing and production organization, this individual will build and manage strategic relationships with global factories, mills, and suppliers while driving operational efficiency, margin improvement, and supply chain reliability. The role requires a strong understanding of apparel manufacturing, global sourcing markets, product construction, and the ability to balance the distinct brand identities, product needs, and business objectives of the brands.

The Director will work closely with Design, Merchandising, Product Development, Planning, Sales, Finance, and Logistics to ensure the business delivers the right product, at the right cost, and on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Sourcing Strategy & Vendor Management**

* Develop and execute a global sourcing strategy that supports the growth, product mix, and business objectives of all brands.
* Build, maintain, and continuously evaluate a competitive network of international factories, mills, suppliers, and sourcing partners.
* Identify new sourcing opportunities, manufacturing capabilities, and geographic diversification to improve cost, quality, capacity, lead times, and supply chain flexibility.
* Establish factory allocation strategies based on product category, construction, technical requirements, order volume, cost, and delivery needs.
* Negotiate pricing, minimums, capacity, payment terms, and production commitments with global vendors.
* Develop long-term strategic vendor partnerships while maintaining accountability for cost competitiveness, quality, service, and delivery performance.
* Evaluate vendor capabilities and performance through regular business reviews, factory assessments, and performance scorecards.
* Lead vendor onboarding and ensure manufacturing partners meet company, brand, and applicable compliance requirements.

**Production Management & Execution**

* Oversee the complete production lifecycle from development handoff and purchase order placement through bulk production, shipment, and final delivery.
* Establish and manage seasonal production calendars, time-and-action schedules, and critical milestones to ensure on-time delivery.
* Monitor production progress across all categories and proactively identify risks related to materials, capacity, approvals, manufacturing, and shipment.
* Ensure production teams maintain accurate and timely communication with factories and internal departments.
* Oversee production allocation and capacity planning across vendors to support seasonal demand and delivery requirements.
* Drive accountability for purchase order accuracy, production status, shipping documentation, and delivery execution.
* Develop contingency plans and resolve production challenges that could impact cost, quality, or delivery.
* Partner with Logistics and Operations to manage shipment schedules, freight decisions, and timely delivery to the distribution center.

**Costing, Margin & Financial Performance**

* Own the costing strategy and process across all brands, ensuring product costs align with margin targets and business objectives.
* Development owns the style costing and merchandising owns the margin, but this role is responsible for overall costing strategies within the vendor matrix and seeks out new opportunities
* Lead cost negotiations with factories and suppliers, identifying opportunities to improve material costs, labor costs, manufacturing efficiencies, and overall product value.
* Partner with Design and Merchandising early in the product creation process to identify cost implications and recommend commercially viable solutions without compromising product integrity.
* Establish costing standards, cost review processes, and approval procedures to ensure accuracy and accountability.
* Analyze factory pricing, raw material costs, duties, freight, and other landed-cost components to identify opportunities for savings.
* Monitor cost changes and production variances, communicating financial impacts and corrective actions to leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in gross margin through strategic sourcing, vendor negotiations, product engineering, and operational efficiencies.

**Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Establish and oversee quality standards and production controls across all product categories.
* Ensure products meet brand specifications, construction standards, fit requirements, testing protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Design, Technical Design, and Product Development to ensure product specifications and construction requirements are clearly communicated to manufacturing partners.
* Oversee quality processes throughout development and bulk production, including testing, inspections, approvals, and corrective actions.
* Ensure factories and suppliers meet applicable social, environmental, safety, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Identify recurring quality issues and implement root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.
* Ensure all products meet applicable brand licensing, labeling, packaging, and approval requirements.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the primary sourcing and production partner to the leadership teams.
* Work closely with Design, Merchandising, Product Development, Planning, Sales, Finance, and Logistics to align product strategy, costing, production timelines, and delivery expectations.
* Provide early visibility into sourcing, costing, quality, and production risks that could impact seasonal business plans.
* Establish clear communication processes and accountability across internal teams and international manufacturing partners.
* Identify opportunities to leverage shared sourcing resources, vendor relationships, and operational efficiencies.
* Provide leadership with regular reporting on production status, cost performance, delivery, quality, and vendor performance.

**Team Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Lead, develop, and manage the sourcing and production team, establishing clear roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Build a culture of accountability, proactive problem solving, collaboration, and operational discipline.
* Develop scalable processes, systems, and reporting tools to improve visibility and efficiency across both brands.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including on time delivery, cost variance, quality performance, vendor performance, and production lead times.
* Continuously evaluate workflows and identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve speed to market, and strengthen execution.
* Develop team capabilities and succession planning to support the long-term needs of the business.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10–15+ years of progressive experience in apparel sourcing, production, manufacturing, or global supply chain management.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing sourcing, production, or manufacturing teams.
* Extensive experience working with international apparel factories, mills, suppliers, and sourcing offices.
* Strong understanding of global apparel manufacturing, including cut-and-sew, knits, wovens, performance apparel, boardshorts, swimwear, and outerwear
* Deep knowledge of garment construction, fabrics, trims, manufacturing processes, costing, and quality standards.
* Proven experience developing global sourcing strategies and managing factory allocation across multiple countries.
* Demonstrated success negotiating costs, improving margins, managing production calendars, and achieving on-time delivery targets.
* Strong understanding of apparel product development and the relationship between design decisions, construction, costing, and manufacturing execution.
* Experience managing multiple brands, product categories, or business units preferred.
* Knowledge of international trade, import regulations, duties, tariffs, and customs requirements.
* Familiarity with responsible sourcing, factory compliance, quality testing, and supply chain risk management.
* Experience with PLM, ERP, production tracking, and reporting systems.
* Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Apparel Manufacturing, or a related field preferred.

**Leadership Profile**

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader who understands both the creative and commercial sides of the apparel business. They can build strong global vendor partnerships, negotiate effectively, solve complex production challenges, and lead teams through demanding seasonal calendars.

This individual must be equally comfortable developing a long-term sourcing strategy and getting into the details of a costing issue, factory delay, or quality concern. They bring a solutions-oriented mindset, strong financial discipline, and the ability to create operational consistency across two distinct global apparel brands.

Success in this role will be measured by improved product margins, competitive and reliable sourcing, consistent product quality, stronger vendor performance, reduced production risk, and on-time delivery across The Brands

new_roles.description:
**Posting End Date:**

November 19, 2026

**Employee Type:**

Regular-Full time

**Union/Non:**

This is a non-union position

As Plant Manager at the Easter location, you will play a pivotal leadership role in ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Enbridge’s Easter Wind facility. As the senior Enbridge representative on site, you will be accountable for the overall performance of the plant, balancing operational excellence with a strong commitment to safety, environmental stewardship, and regulatory compliance. You will lead day-to-day operations while fostering a positive, inclusive, and safety-first culture aligned with Enbridge’s values and expectations.

 

In this role, you will work collaboratively with internal teams, contractors, service providers, and community stakeholders to deliver strong operational and financial results. You will provide hands-on leadership across operations, maintenance, asset integrity, and compliance, while maintaining financial discipline and transparency. If you are an experienced leader who thrives in a dynamic operational environment, values continuous improvement, and takes pride in enabling reliable renewable energy production, apply today. #joinourteam

 

**What You Will Do**

* Lead safe and reliable operations by managing all operational and maintenance activities for wind turbines and Balance of Plant (BOP) assets, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, CIP, FAA) and Enbridge safety standards.

* Champion a strong safety culture by ensuring adherence to safety policies and procedures, overseeing contractor and partner performance, and ensuring timely and accurate reporting and investigation of safety incidents and metrics.

* Manage people and contractors on site, including daily supervision, site orientations, performance oversight, and effective engagement with service providers, landowners, and internal stakeholders.

* Execute asset maintenance and integrity plans, ensuring all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities are planned, scheduled, tracked, and completed to Enbridge standards using systems such as MAXIMO.

* Oversee compliance and operational excellence, conducting audits, monitoring performance, managing lost production, and proactively addressing operational issues in collaboration with operations, engineering, and asset management teams.

* Drive financial performance and accountability by developing and managing the facility’s budget, forecasts, P&L reporting, explaining variances, managing procurement and work orders, and identifying opportunities for cost optimization and efficiency.

Provide clear reporting and leadership visibility, delivering accurate facility performance, safety, environmental, and financial reporting, and representing Enbridge as a trusted, responsible partner in the operation of the facility. 

 

**What you bring:**

* Related university degree and seven-plus years’ experience OR nine ‐ plus years of previous field operations experience, OR equivalent mix of formal education and experience.

* Valid Driver’s License and ability to obtain a Passport.

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience including 3 years in a supervisory or management role.

* Strong electrical systems knowledge preferred, with ability to troubleshoot SCADA, substations, collection systems, and met towers; wind generation plant experience considered an asset.

* Demonstrated commitment to safety, ability to perform calmly under pressure, and strong problem‑solving and decision‑making capability.

* Proven people leadership, contract administration experience, and ability to build effective relationships with employees, contractors, landowners, municipalities, and community stakeholders.

Strong communication and integrity, customer-focused mindset, willingness to learn Enbridge systems and processes, and digital proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel) and Oracle. 

 

**Working Conditions:**

* This role will require being on-call (24/7) to respond to emergencies and/or maintenance needs of the site (on a pre-determined, scheduled basis).

* Plant Manager must reside within 75 miles of the site due to on-call requirements.

Travel may be required from time to time both within the United States and Canada (approximately 10-20%) 

 

The successful candidate will undergo various background screening that includes but is not limited to a 5-year driving record, criminal check, a company sponsored medical and drug testing.

 

**Physical Requirements:**

Must meet requirements of fit for work which includes, but is not limited to, demonstrating hand, arm, back and leg coordination needed to ascend and descend a wind tower and comply with a weight restriction of 132 kg (or 290lb) total climbing weight. Comfort with completing physically demanding tasks in all weather conditions and comfort working in enclosed spaces and at heights of 300 ft. Employee understands that these requirements may be modified at the Company's discretion.

Grasping, kneeling, light – moderate lifting (objects up to 45 pounds), reaching above shoulder, repetitive motion, sitting, standing, visual requirement (able to see screens, detect color coding, read fine print), hearing requirement.

 

**Mental Requirements:**

Ability to: understand, remember and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information, understand sophisticated problems and collaborate/explore alternative solutions, organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology, coordinate and prioritize work schedule on a short-term basis, make decisions which have moderate impact on the immediate work unit and monitor impact outside this area, understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines, complete routine forms, compose letters, outlines, memoranda and basic reports and connect with individuals via telephone.

 

**Base Salary:**

* Base salary ranges from $120,000 – $135,000 USD for US locations based upon candidate’s experience, skills, and internal equity.

Applicable compensation policies and guidelines apply to internal candidates. 

 

**Benefits:**

* A flexible benefits program that allows each employee to select the level of coverage needed for their family in the areas of health, dental, insurance, and disability.

* A paid maternity and parental leave benefit that offers up to 20 weeks of paid leave for birth-giving parents and up to 12 weeks for other eligible parents, providing flexibility and support during this important life event.

* Valuable retirement savings plans, including a savings plan with company stock as an investment option.

* Paid time off/vacation/sick, plus paid personal days off (depending on location), and paid holidays.

* An Employee and Family Assistance Program.

A Wellness Program, which focuses on supporting healthier employees by providing tools, resources, and opportunities to improve physical, mental, social, and financial well-being.

Carnegie, PA

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the unique perspectives of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders, and cultures across the world. We believe that a variety of backgrounds makes our team stronger and more innovative.

**At Airgas, we RESPECT, HONOR and VALUE diversity.**
=====================================================

 

**Airgas is Hiring for a Plant Manager in Carnegie, PA**
========================================================

 

***We are looking for you !***

 

* **Comprehensive Family Benefits:** Airgas offers a full benefits package designed to support your whole life, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance.
* **Support for Parents:** We offer a 14-week paid child birth benefit to support growing families.
* **Future Security:** 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, Tuition Assistance, Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick time.
* **Early Access:** Your benefits start after just 30 days of employment.

 

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading and empowering the team engaged in producing and repackaging of compressed and liquid gases into cylinders, correcting unsafe acts or conditions without delay, and aligning daily responsibilities with team members according to customer needs, current stock levels and team strengths.

* Ensures the safe operation and maintenance of the plant for pumping or repackaging of gases into cylinders while ensuring compliance with all federal, state, local and company policies, procedures, regulations and laws. Maintains a neat, clean and orderly plant appearance.
* Studies production schedules and estimates team-hour requirements for completion of job assignments. Establishes and/or adjusts work procedures collaboratively to meet production schedules.
* Partners with the team to enhance production methods, equipment performance, and product quality. Adapts workflows and use of equipment to support team productivity and well-being.
* Ensures all safety rules are strictly observed and safety training is regularly scheduled, conducted and documented. Interpret company policies to team members and foster a culture of safety adherence.
* Ensures all injuries and accidents are properly investigated and reported within 24 hours.
* Analyzes and resolves, or partners with team members in solving, work related problems. Supports career growth, internal movement, and constructive performance management. Ensures associate issues, grievances, etc. are effectively handled.
* Mentors and guides operational leaders to cultivate effective leadership. Design collaborative initiatives to inspire and engage the team to achieve goals. Provides coaching and corrective action promptly, to ensure that team members receiving feedback are supported to meet shared performance goals.
* Onboards new team members and supports cross-functional learning to continue production during personnel shortages.
* Maintains time and production records and approves overtime when essential, while keeping overtime at acceptable levels.
* Collaborates with outside sales to ensure order accuracy and properly scheduled customer deliveries by Airgas trucks.
* Monitors SAP reports daily such as open order/delivery reports, billing and delivery block reports and open Purchase Order (PO) reports.
* Oversees employee development in procedural areas such as following all Airgas Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS) and safety regulations.
* Run recurring orders for the next day's deliveries.
* Route all the trucks and PGI tickets.
* Complete Daily Cycle Counts.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
----------------------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED
* A total of five (5) years of industry experience to include a minimum of two (2) years of demonstrated experience working in a supervisory/leadership role. Prefer prior experience with compressed/packaged gases.

**Prefered Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* Prior experience utilizing SAP preferred.
* Intermediate knowledge of Google suite applications
* Strong analytical skills and a thorough understanding of how to leverage metrics and related tools to improve production efficiency and effectiveness.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Communication skills that ensure a smooth flow of information between self and others through clear speaking and writing, encouragement of open expression of ideas, and effective listening.

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deal effectively with others in both favorable and unfavorable situations regardless of status of position. Accepts cultural diversity and establishes effective working relationships.
* Demonstrated knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in all units of measure using whole numbers, fractions and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratios, and percent.

* Lives by Airgas safety programs, OSHA, and all related rules, regulations, procedures which are applicable to this position’s responsibilities

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Benefits**

We care about and support our Airgas Families. This is evident not only through our competitive compensation but also through a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision plans, short-term and long-term disability, life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), pre-tax commuter transportation benefit, parental leave, vacation, sick time, floating holidays, jury duty and funeral/bereavement leave, and paid holidays for all eligible full-time employees.

Additionally, we offer our eligible employees a 401k plan with company matching funds, tuition reimbursement, discounted college tuition for eligible employees’ dependents, and an Airgas Scholarship Program for dependent children.

Associates who are members of collective bargaining units should review their bargaining agreement to determine whether they are eligible for some or all of the benefits described here and to see any special terms or conditions for eligibility.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Your DIFFERENCES enhance our PERFORMANCE**

At Airgas, we are committed to building a workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability or any other protected characteristic. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**About Airgas**

Airgas, an Air Liquide company, is a leading U.S. supplier of industrial, medical and specialty gases, as well as hardgoods and related products; one of the largest U.S. suppliers of safety products; and a leading U.S. supplier of ammonia products and process chemicals. Through the passion and diversity of its 18,000 associates, Airgas fosters a culture of safety, customer success, sustainability and innovation. Airgas associates are empowered to share ideas, take initiative and make decisions.

Airgas is a subsidiary of Air Liquide, a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. Present in 60 countries with approximately 66,500 employees, Air Liquide serves more than 4 million customers and patients.

Join us for a stimulating experience: At Airgas, you matter and so does the work you do. As a member of our team, you play an important role in the success of your team, making sure our products are created sustainably and delivered safely and efficiently. In turn, you’ll find a welcoming workplace where you’re valued for who you are and where you can fill your potential while growing a fulfilling career — whatever path you choose.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Airgas, an Air Liquide Company is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - Food Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Region Director of Operation, the **Plant Manager** has leadership responsibility in developing high-performing teams, driving operational excellence, and creating a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

As the **Plant Manager**, you will play a critical role in shaping the success of our facility by overseeing daily production operations, optimizing processes, and ensuring we consistently deliver high-quality products to our customers.

You will lead through collaboration, innovation, and a hands-on approach, empowering your team to identify opportunities, overcome challenges, and achieve meaningful results.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Facility leadership and general management activities.
* P&L responsibility for the Facility through creating and managing budgets that help achieve financial goals.
* Develop processes that will maximize stewardship, safety, quality, and productivity.
* The Plant Manager will ensure compliance with governing health/safety regulations and procedures.
* Assist in recruiting, hiring, retention, and developing of associates. This includes evaluations and performance documentation.
* Strategically create and adjust department activities, policies, and procedures to meet or exceed key performance metrics and customer satisfaction goals.
* Writes and adjust Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) to ensure standardization throughout network.
* Leads Facility teams on Gemba (waste) walks and manages solutions to improve findings
* Analyzes, identifies, and proposes action to the solution of problems with the operation of the division departments to increase the effectiveness of the operation.
* Ensures all DOT regulations are met in the transportation department
* Instrumental in the Development of key metrics and indices to drive improvement within daily, weekly, monthly, and annual results.
* Serves as a Facility spokesperson in cases of inquiry, feedback, or requests for special information to facilitate the accurate and precise flow of information.
* Aids in the solicitation of new or prospective business by participating in company meetings and any other market activities to foster the company’s recognition within the business community.
* Maintain high quality and safety standards by following specifications, local and federal governance, and Sysco’s quality programs (including 3rd party auditing).

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering or Agriculture preferred or min 10 years’ experience in in operational leadership

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years plant leadership in food production, manufacturing, costing, and distribution experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Financial responsibility
* Increasing leadership history
* Great verbal and written communication skills
* Lean Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing experience
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Teams, Access, and Outlook
* Experience and understanding of ERP systems

**PROFESSIONAL SKILLS**

* Deep experience with manufacturing or production processes to include continuous improvement tools
* **Active Listening:** Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.
* **Management of Personnel Resources**: Motivating, developing, and directing people as they work, identifying the best people for the job.
* **Social Perceptiveness**: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.
* **Coordination**: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions
* **Critical Thinking:** Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
* **Reading Comprehension**: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.
* **Oral Comprehension**: Listening to and understanding the information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
* **Written Comprehension**: Reading and understanding the information and ideas presented in writing.
* **Written Expression**: Communicating information and ideas in writing so others will understand
* **Judgment and Decision Making**: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.
* **Negotiation:** Bringing others together and trying to reconcile differences.
* **Complex Problem Solving**: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.
* **Deductive Reasoning**: Applying general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.
* **Problem Sensitivity**: Perceiving when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing there is a problem.
* **Fluency of Ideas**: Coming up with several ideas about a topic (the number of ideas is important, not their quality, correctness, or creativity).

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* The ability to sit, stand, walk, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and telephone to talk and hear.
* The ability to frequently sit and reach with hands and arms.
* The ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

**WORK CONDITIONS**

* The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by associates within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of associates assigned to this job.
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
* The requirements listed above are representative of knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Must be able to utilize office equipment such as desktop/notebook computers, copiers, printers, scanners, telephones, and calculators.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
* Must be able to work in various indoor and outdoor climates and driving conditions. This includes Cold and wet manufacturing environments.
* Occasional Travel to attend meetings may be required.

*NOTICE: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of the environment and the level of work being performed by this job. This job description in no way states or implies that the duties and responsibilities listed are the only tasks to be performed by the employee in this job. The employee will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by his or her supervisor. This job description supersedes prior job descriptions. When duties and responsibilities change and develop the job description will be reviewed and subject to changes of business necessity.*

11-15-2026

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager will direct the activities of the plant employees in a safe, compliant, reliable, and economical manner including electric power production, maintenance, engineering, construction, accounting, procurement, materials management, human resources, public affairs, tax matters and compliance with regulating agencies. Responsible for establishing and maintaining two-way communications with employees, managers and the general public. Provide leadership and manage change by the development of a culture that promotes/supports teamwork, process improvement activities, employee development, and proper recognition and reward.

**Job Description**

**What You'll Do:**

 

* Plan, organize, coordinate, direct and control plant activities including the operation, maintenance, engineering and construction of the plant's facilities in a safe, efficient and economical manner.
* Support the System Safety Process. Develop, maintain and enforce safe working conditions by providing proper and adequate tools, equipment, protective clothing and devices, and training. Establish and enforce safe work behaviors. Participate in the setting of safety goals for an accident-free work environment. Communicate to employees about the importance of a safe work environment on a daily basis. Investigate, report and track incidents/accidents including root cause analysis and corrective action taken. Report findings to management and to employees.
* Develop long range plans for maintenance and operational excellence, capital improvements, equipment availability, cultural transformation, and the plant organization's succession planning requirements.
* Direct long range planning activities including maintenance management, materials management, QA/QC, human resources, accounting, predictive and preventative maintenance systems, and public relations.
* Develop short range (three years to coincide with the investment review committee) plan and forecasts in cooperation with engineering and maintenance personnel; develop budgets, prepare variance reports and control expenditures to meet approved budgets.
* Direct the operation of plant activities to ensure compliance with all local, state and federal laws and regulations and compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Participate in the formulation of company policies and procedures pertaining to plant operations.
* Establish and maintain close liaison with city, county, local and other officials and industrial leaders, and inform appropriate persons of actions, proposals and plans that have a bearing on plant operations and activities.

**What We're Looking For:**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, business management; or associate degree in a technical field, chemistry, environmental services, accounting, or equivalent applied knowledge (see experience).

Experience: Minimum of 8 years' experience including work in plant operations, maintenance, and performance areas. Experience should include business/financial and human resources administration. A minimum of eight years supervising others. OTHER REQUIREMENTS: Physical demand level is Sedentary.

Training should include company courses in leadership, supervision, change-management, team skills, problem solving & decision making, process improvement, safety, business skills and other relevant courses.

**What You’ll Get:**

In addition to a competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

Join Amrize as a Plant Manager - Aggregate and help construct what's next. If you're ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America — we want to hear from you!

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The basic function of the Plant Manager is to provide the necessary leadership to plan, direct, organize, coordinate and control the mining of raw materials and the production of shippable product at the assigned Plant in a manner to meet Aggregate Dispatcher requests on a timely and cost efficient basis. The Plant Manager will be tasked with ensuring that an appropriate quality product is made at the Plant.

The Plant Manager will ensure proper staffing and monitoring of the inventory status at the Plant and in addition will coordinate activities with the following departments: Aggregate Operations Department - Dispatch, Maintenance, and Quality Control of the Region in addition Regional Administration/Financial function.

The Plant Manager will analyze and monitor production efficiency / productivity to ensure the Company is fully utilizing on site vehicles and plant equipment at the assigned location. In addition, the Plant Manager will develop mining and production strategies and tactics to ensure an approach to raise productivity levels, maintaining safety as a top propriety, while controlling the costs of the assigned location.

 

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Consistently identify new operational opportunities and develop strategies for accomplishing the attainment of improved efficiency and productivity.
* Address the needs of the customer while at the same time promoting and protecting the long-term interests of the Company.
* Initiate and implement production and scheduling related programs, strategies and techniques that result in increased productivity, and maintain safe operations of the assigned Plant, while containing the budgeted expenses of the assigned plants.
* Manage the performances of subordinate personnel, work independently, meet deadlines and manage the assigned Plant with fiscal integrity.
* Delegate responsibilities; must be able to objectively evaluate the performance of subordinates; and must be able to hold others accountable in a constructive manner.
* Participate in Company safety inspections.
* Communicate with site crew which includes plant operator, loader operators and laborers
* Supervise team to maintain production and efficiency. Schedule production and execute preventative maintenance routines
* Maintain sufficient inventory levels at site to service customers’ needs
* Coordinate safety issues and investigate incidents with safety department. Ensure environmental compliance, rehabilitation and meeting permit obligations
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree

**Field of Study Preferred:** Mining Engineering, Management
 
**Required Work Experience**: 5-7 years Aggregate Mining and related Raw Materials Plant Production experience

**Required Technical Skills:** Computer proficiency required. SAP experience would be a plus

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. * Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)

new_roles.description:
**Job Title: Plant Manager**

**Job Type: On-Site**

**Location: Orange, CA**

**Reporting to: VP of Manufacturing**

**Company Overview**

FXI is a leading producer of foam innovation in the Bedding, Furniture, Industrial, Home & Office, Healthcare, and Transportation markets. We have made it our mission to provide tailored solutions that delight our customers and consumers. With our corporate headquarters, high-tech research and development facility, and multiple manufacturing locations in North America, FXI has built a culture of innovation and achievement that is recognized by customers, suppliers and peers. Our products include finished goods, sub-assemblies, services, and raw materials for OEMs, fabricators, and retailers. You will find FXI's foam innovations inside, around, and under yourself in countless applications. Everywhere foam goes, FXI's innovations lead the way! Won't you join us?

**Job Overview:**

Reporting to the Manufacturing Vice President, the Plant Manager plans, directs, and coordinates the operations of the plant. The Plant Manager has leadership responsibility to assure compliance with all government and company policies and procedures. This position will also be responsible for facility production goals and objectives. Following FXI's Vision, Mission and Values, the Plant Manager is to develop a well-trained and motivated staff with emphasis on plant safety and employee engagement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Chemical, or related discipline) preferred.

* Direct and coordinate plant operations in strict compliance with all state and federal laws, regulations, corporate policies and procedures
* Responsible for achieving all facility business goals including, but not limited to, the areas of safety, quality, production, reliability and P&L.

* Maintain a clean and safe plant; incorporate a 5S culture for conducting all work activities.

* Develop and foster a high‑performing, well‑trained, and motivated workforce by assessing current skill sets and aligning talent development with the plant's future growth, vision, and manufacturing excellence across all functions.

* Lead the development, implementation, and governance of plant performance metrics and KPIs to monitor progress toward site objectives and drive continuous improvement.

* Conduct and assure all required employee development and performance reviews are completed to promote individual continuous improvement per the required corporate schedule.

* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings. Need to be a key leader moving the company forward to meet strategic and business plan objectives.
* Ensures that all plant assets are properly managed, safeguarded, and secure.

* Develop, submit for approval, and implement approved Capital Projects as required to meet facility strategic plans and business needs.

* Develop and ensure management systems are in place to monitor plant output, cuts / yields and scrap to ensure efficient resource utilization and initiate corrective action as required.

* Establish and maintain a positive community relationship.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 years of prior experience in a manufacturing environment
* Prior experience as Production / Operations Manager.
* Strong interpersonal, problem solving and leadership skills with the ability to lead a team motivate the group and manage a diverse workforce.
* Excellent, engaging communicator; able to set measurable goals and expectations and hold team members accountable for results

* Demonstrated experience and working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and structured problem‑solving tools (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, A3, 5 Whys) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Action-oriented and eager to drive programs through to completion. Able to deal with pressures and timelines inherent in a fast-paced company
* Ability to quickly assess the situation at the plant and have an impact on the direction of improvements
* Ability to function as a strong leader, bringing the Operations perspective while promoting cross-functional horizontal alignment to achieve key company goals
* Hands-on leader who contributes to overall business strategy and issues, works well as part of the leadership team, and is focused upon achieving results
* Team player and coach who will promote cooperation among employees in the organization and an environment of employee engagement
* Possess the confidence and presence to be able to deal effectively with external customers, vendors, and all levels within the organization
* Strong, self-confident, decisive leader with excellent listening skills, emotional maturity, and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

**Our Commitment to a Diverse Workforce:** FXI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. FXI does not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or based on any individual's membership in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We support workplace diversity. We strongly believe that diversity contributes to a broader collective perspective that will consistently lead to a better company and better products. We are working hard to increase the diversity of our team wherever we can.

***We are interested in every*** ***qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.***

FXI is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at FXI via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of FXI. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by FXI as a result of the referral or through other means.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Plant manager will provide leadership and direction to ensure the continual, efficient and uniform operation which will meet or exceed customer expectations in a safe and orderly manner.
 
He/she will develop and implement plans coordinated with the Corporate Business Plan to increase the reliability and continually improve the quality and efficiencies of the products and services provided by the business unit.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Supervise branch production using RMAS Warehouse Management System and available Production Planning tools
* Develop plans and procedures to insure the safety of all employees and visitors of the warehouse and Clarify and correct any incorrect warehouse procedures
* Ensure operations and equipment is in compliance to corporate guidelines and OSHA Standards
* Verify inventory and make adjustments where necessary
* Hire, train and motivate warehouse employees to build bench strength and increase retention by scheduling and provide training for growth and compliance
* Maintain equipment to provide maximum availability and minimum down time
* Evaluate and recommend new equipment purchases to enhance quality, capabilities and productivity
* Communicate and monitor progress towards company safety, returns and allowances, and on time shipment and delivery directives
* Responsible for building maintenance and security
* Monitor quality and process improvement throughout the warehouse using SAP reports
* Ensure that preventive and corrective action methods are followed to eliminate or correct procedures and practices which do not meet customer requirements
* Follow progressive disciplinary action to adhere to policy and procedures
* Ensure adequate support of the sales department and its customers in a timely and orderly manner
* Assist with customer problems, including on-site visits where necessary
* Facilitate Lean practices in the Plant
* Purchase or direct the purchase of necessary warehouse supplies to insure the ability to comply with written work instructions and customer requirements
* Attend regional and corporate meetings when required
* Perform employee reviews as required
* Assist in contract negotiations, where applicable
* This is a position that works directly on the warehouse floor on or around heavy machinery
* Meets TKMNA Employee Attributes/Competencies

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirement for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

Accordingly, any application for this position that is considered for employment with thyssenkrupp requires successful completion of pre-employment drug testing, which may include testing for marijuana in accordance with any applicable federal, state, and local laws.**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred (in a Business, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Behavioral Science curriculum)
* Two years direct Warehouse Supervision or team leadership, experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Office application, Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint a must
* An understanding of Basic Lean Manufacturing Principles
* Safety Mindset

* MBA, Master’s degree or Ph.D. is a plus

new_roles.description:
**Lead Operations. Build Teams. Drive Growth.**

Are you a hands-on operations leader who thrives on building high-performing teams, improving processes, and delivering results? UFP Factory Built is looking for a Plant Manager to lead one of our manufacturing facilities and play a key role in the success of our growing business.

 

As a Plant Manager, you'll have the opportunity to run the operation like it's your own, leading production, safety, quality, inventory, maintenance, and team development while making a direct impact on profitability and customer satisfaction. This is an ideal role for a leader who enjoys solving problems, developing people, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**About UFP Factory Built**

UFP Factory Built, a division of UFP Industries, supplies structural components and engineered solutions for manufactured housing, modular construction, RV, and cargo trailer manufacturers throughout North America. We are part of a stable, growth-oriented organization with a strong reputation for investing in our people and promoting from within.

 

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead all day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and profitability goals are achieved.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of supervisors and production employees.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, waste reduction, and efficiency initiatives.
* Manage production scheduling, inventory levels, shipping activities, and resource planning.
* Monitor key performance metrics and take action to improve throughput, quality, and financial results.
* Partner with leadership on capital investments, facility improvements, and business growth initiatives.
* Foster a culture centered around safety, employee engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA standards, and all applicable regulations.
Oversee maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime. 

 

### **What We're Looking For**

* Experience leading manufacturing, production, operations, or industrial teams.
* Proven ability to motivate employees, develop talent, and drive results.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, costs, and operational metrics.
* Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and implement effective solutions.
* Experience with inventory management, production scheduling, and process improvement.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Forklift certification or willingness to obtain certification. 

 

### **Why Join UFP?**

* Opportunity to lead and influence all aspects of a manufacturing operation.
* High visibility and direct impact on business performance.
* Stable and growing company with a strong national footprint.
* Collaborative culture that values leadership, innovation, and accountability.
* Career advancement opportunities within UFP Industries.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. 

 

### **What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you'll build a safe, efficient, and engaged operation, develop future leaders, improve plant performance, and help position the facility for continued growth. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, the support of an experienced leadership team, and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the business.

 

**If you're a driven operations leader looking to take ownership of a facility, develop teams, and grow your career with an industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Benefits** **currently offered to our employees:**

* Medical Insurance
* Health Savings Account with Company Contribution
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Paid Vacation and Holidays
* Stock Purchase Program with Employee Discount
* Education Reimbursement
* Wellness Programs and Challenges
Other Supplemental Benefits 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Heidelberg Materials is one of the world's largest suppliers of building materials. Heidelberg Materials North America operates over 450 locations across the U.S. and Canada with approximately 9,000 employees.

 

The Plant Manager role is based at our slag grinding facility in Cape Canaveral, FL and reports directly to the Vice President of Cement Operations.

 

### **What You’ll Be Doing**

 

* Leads plant safety program to ensure a safe working environment. Ensures all company safety policies are implemented and followed.

* Actively participate in the development of the plant’s objectives and oversee all aspects of daily plant production and maintenance activities to optimize plant performance.

* Provide input into plant capital plan and operation plan and effectively manage budget costs.

* Plans, coordinates and directs all production activities to ensure that Plant Operations goals and targets are realized.

* Analyzes plant activities on a daily basis to assess and recommend areas for improvements in production, quality or efficiency.

* Synchronizes production activities with quarry, maintenance, process and quality control activities to make certain that the plant is performing to highest standards.

* Manages the team to ensure production requirements are met.

* Oversee plant maintenance.

* Ensure that the maintenance and operation of equipment is at optimal levels.

* Guides and directs maintenance managers to minimize equipment downtime.

* Plans, organizes and oversees the annual plant shut down.

* Ensures HTC Maintenance initiatives are implemented.

* Leads and fosters the collaborative efforts of the plant staff to address operating methods, procedures, and problems toward continuous improvement of production quality and efficiency. Identifies training needs of plant staff and ensures that appropriate training is implemented.

* Fully support the company’s purchasing initiative and ensure that purchasing policies and contract management policies and procedures are adhered to in the plant.

* Work in partnership with Plant Purchasing personnel regarding the purchase of major equipment.

* In collaboration with Sales and Marketing stay abreast of customer requirements and concerns.

* Determine and oversee the timely resolution to issues stemming from production, quality, etc.

* Participate in community activities to continually promote plant/community relations.

* Works with the plant Quality Control Department to meet product specifications and production goals

* Ensure compliance with plant policies & procedures, safety, environmental, state and federal process regulations.

* Ensure implementation of company policies and procedures.

* Responsible for the flawless execution of the Plant on call schedule, participating as needed.

* Leads and fosters the collaborative efforts of the plant staff to address operating methods, procedures, and problems toward continuous improvement of production quality and efficiency.

### **What Are We Looking For**

* A College Degree in Engineering or related field.

* 5 or more years progressive experience managing operations in a slag grinding facility

* Synchronize production activities with quarry, maintenance, process and quality control activities to make certain that the plant is performing to highest standards.

* Manage the team to ensure production requirements are met.

* Oversee plant maintenance.

* Ensure that the maintenance and operation of equipment is at optimal levels.

* Guide and direct maintenance manager to minimize equipment downtime.

* In coordination with Plant Management, plan, organizes and oversee the annual plant shut down.

* Ensure HTC Maintenance initiatives are implemented.

* A high level of technical knowledge related to all aspects of cement manufacturing

* Familiar with Central Control operations, including the process control system in a preheater plant with a pre-calciner and alternate fuels experience an asset.

* Managerial and leadership competencies acquired in progressively more responsible positions in a unionized plant with the ability to perform in roles of both plant manager and direct reports on a relief basis.

* Ability to make timely, critical decisions, often under conditions of uncertainty and stress.

* Detailed knowledge about process equipment interlocking; Knowledge in mill liner installation and ball charge design.

* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

* Proficient with windows-based PC software programs including MS Office, SAP and other applicable software programs.

* Ability to read and understand financial statements and cost reports, prepare budget and forecasts and to focus on and manage costs.

* Strong interpersonal, leadership and motivational skills.

* Ability to communicate effectively and interact as a team member in a Total Quality environment

### **What We Offer**

 

* Competitive base salary, $139,100 to $185,460 annually and participation in our annual incentive plan.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with an automatic company contribution as well as matching contributions.
* Highly competitive benefits programs, including:

* + Medical, Dental, and Vision along with Prescription Drug Benefits
 + Health Savings Account (HSA), Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
 + AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability Coverage as well as Basic Life Insurance
 + Paid Bonding Leave, 15 days of Paid Vacation, 40 hours of Paid Sick Leave and 10 Paid Holidays

Equal Opportunity Employer - Minority / Female / Veteran / Disabled.

new_roles.description:

Organize, formulate and prepare Monthly, Weekly and Daily Production Schedules (DPS) and SBS forecast sheets to conform to product receipt and delivery dates, manufacturing capacities and available inventory capacities.

Plan, direct and supervise the scheduling, production and control operations to achieve receipt and production goals in conformance with date commitments, relative to delivery schedules. Responsible for the accuracy of daily tank inventories, relative to materials received, storage arrangements and efficient handling methods, timely distribution to manufacturing and shipping areas to avoid delays and interruption of production operations and in compliance with the daily production schedule.

Personally supervise and expedite rush orders and revise Daily Production Schedules to offset delays caused by manufacturing malfunction, engineering changes, revised shipment dates, cancellations, etc.

Through daily surveillance of the Utility Sheet, Supplies and Repairs Breakdown, and Daily time sheets, control costs in conformance with budget guidelines. Advise Operations Manager where and when costs are above budget guidelines and recommend corrective actions.

Assist in planning and execution of capital improvement projects.

Supervise daily quality control sampling and testing on an "as needed" basis in accordance with the Quality Control Program.

Perform other duties as assigned, including general labor.
