existing_roles.title: Executive Director, Project Management, Industrialization
existing_roles.description:
**About Blue Bird Corporation**

Blue Bird (NASDAQ: BLBD) is recognized as a technology leader and innovator of school buses since its founding in 1927. Our dedicated team members design, engineer and manufacture school buses with a singular focus on safety, reliability, and durability. School buses carry the most precious cargo in the world – 25 million children twice a day – making them the most trusted mode of student transportation. The company is the proven leader in low- and zero-emission school buses with more than 25,000 propane, natural gas, and electric powered buses sold. Blue Bird is transforming the student transportation industry through cleaner energy solutions. For more information on Blue Bird’s complete product and service portfolio, visit www.blue-bird.com (https://www.blue-bird.com/).

 

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Executive Director, Project Management, Industrialization will lead manufacturing and production readiness for the next-generation F53/F59 chassis platform, integrating Plan for Every Part (PFEP), continuous improvement (CI), Lean manufacturing, and operational excellence into the industrialization plan. This role will coordinate facilities, tooling, equipment, materials flow, process capability, quality systems, workforce readiness, and production ramp to support Q1 2028 production within approved budget, schedule, safety, and quality requirements.

This is a hands-on role accountable for personally developing and maintaining detailed project plans, resolving plant-level execution issues, and influencing action across functions without direct reports. Responsibilities extend beyond launch to sustaining PFEP, improving operating performance, and developing repeatable manufacturing and supply chain practices.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Industrialization and production readiness**

* Develop, document, and maintain the integrated industrialization plan, including milestones, dependencies, accountable owners, resource requirements, readiness criteria, and recovery actions.
* Drive production realization across facilities, tooling, equipment installation, line layout, manufacturing processes, quality readiness, staffing, training, materials management, and chassis shipping.
* Track capital milestones, budget commitments, capacity assumptions, process validation, and production ramp readiness; work with functional owners to close gaps and escalate decisions affecting launch.
* Work directly with plant teams to validate readiness on the production floor, resolve execution issues, and manage risks to safety, quality, cost, delivery, and business continuity.
* Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of PFEP with supply chain, materials, manufacturing engineering, and production teams, establishing data ownership and change controls that remain effective after launch.
* Ensure PFEP defines part requirements, supplier and lead-time information, packaging, storage locations, inventory parameters, replenishment methods, and point-of-use delivery requirements.
* Translate PFEP into practical receiving, storage, kitting, line-side delivery, and replenishment processes. Validate material availability and flow against production demand, space, handling, safety, and capacity requirements.
* Use PFEP data to identify and reduce shortages, excess inventory, unnecessary handling, and production interruptions; coordinate corrective actions with functional owners.
* Support the development of inbound and outbound logistics plans in collaboration with plant team members and third-party vendors, including delivery schedules, transportation capacity, staging, and finished chassis shipping, aligned with production demand and ramp requirements.

 

**Continuous improvement Lean and operational excellence**

* Develop and execute a prioritized CI and operational excellence roadmap that supports launch readiness and sustained performance after launch, with documented baselines, owners, milestones, and measurable benefits.
* Lead practical Lean initiatives, including value stream mapping, standard work, 5S, visual management, line balancing, and structured problem-solving to improve safety, quality, productivity, material flow, and delivery.
* Facilitate improvement events and coach plant teams in root-cause analysis and corrective action. Establish follow-up routines and measures to confirm improvements are adopted and sustained.
* Document repeatable manufacturing and supply chain practices, lessons learned, and standard processes; support their application across other Blue Bird operations as assigned.

 

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES FOR SUCCESS**

* Strong knowledge of manufacturing launch, capital projects, equipment installation, process validation, quality readiness, workforce planning, and production ramp execution.
* Practical expertise in PFEP, material flow design, inventory management, replenishment systems, and integration of materials processes with production requirements.
* Ability to apply Lean and CI methods to solve operational problems and sustain measurable results.
* Ability to lead through influence, secure cross-functional commitments, resolve competing priorities, and escalate issues with clear recommendations.
* Strong planning, documentation, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to personally build and maintain detailed schedules, trackers, and performance reports.
* Ability to move between leadership discussions and detailed work on the production floor, adapting to changing requirements while maintaining accountability for results.

 

**BASIC EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of project management, manufacturing launch, industrialization, operations, plant engineering, or production readiness experience.
* 8+ years demonstrated experience implementing PFEP or comparable part-level materials planning systems and leading Lean, CI, or operational excellence initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* All candidates must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility at the time of hire.

 

**WE VALUE**

* Ability to anticipate and understand customer needs and provide guidance
* Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills to handle difficult and sensitive matters.
* Strong project management skills. Exposure to difficult or complex projects a plus.
* Ability to influence stakeholders
* Effective communication and ability to communicate complex details in a clear manner.
* Flexible workspaces and work hours to help you unleash the best you.
* Working in a collaborative team and balancing the needs of individual stakeholders while delivering corporate objectives.

 

**INCLUDES**

* Continued Professional Development
* Benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 14 paid holidays, vacation time and 401k matching

 

**WORK CONDITIONS**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Office environment and production environment
* Must work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to heat, cold and noise
* Fast-paced production area with moving objects and sheet metal
* Occasional periods of standing or sitting for extended periods of time
* You must wear appropriate PPE when and where required
* Frequent weeks working 40+ hours
* Frequent communication with people throughout the day

 

* The specific statements shown in each section of this description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria necessary to successfully perform the job. existing_roles.description:
The Plant Manager will oversee all operations at the Atlanta Plant, ensuring that production goals are met while maintaining high standards of quality and safety. This role is crucial in driving efficiency and productivity, as well as fostering a positive work environment for all employees. The Plant Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing strategic plans that align with the company's objectives, while also managing budgets and resources effectively. Additionally, this position will involve collaborating with various departments to optimize processes and address any operational challenges. Ultimately, the Plant Manager will play a key role in enhancing the plant's performance and contributing to the overall success of the organization.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience in a laundry processing facility, with a minimum of 3 years in a management role.
* Strong understanding of production processes, quality control, and safety regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies.
* Proven track record of successfully managing large teams and complex projects.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage daily operations of the plant, ensuring production targets are met.
* Develop and implement operational strategies to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and quality standards throughout the facility.
* Manage and mentor plant staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and teamwork.
* Analyze production data and metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.

**Skills:**

The required skills for this role include strong leadership and communication abilities, which are essential for managing a diverse team and ensuring effective collaboration across departments. Analytical skills are crucial for interpreting production data and making informed decisions that drive operational improvements. Problem-solving skills will be utilized daily to address challenges that arise in the production process, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. Additionally, knowledge of safety regulations and quality standards will be applied to maintain compliance and uphold the plant's reputation. Preferred skills, such as experience with Lean Manufacturing, will enhance the ability to implement efficient processes and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

existing_roles.description:
**TITLE:** Plant Manager
 
 
**POSITION OBJECTIVE:** The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day operation, leadership and management direction to ensure safety, quality, financial, operational, productivity and delivery goals are met to ensure customer satisfaction. This role requires the timely and accurate completion of reports on key production metrics such as efficiency, downtime, and cost. The Plant Manager plays a vital role in promoting a culture of safety by leading awareness initiatives, addressing safety issues, and managing incident investigations. This position reports to the Director of Manufacturing.
 
 
**QUALIFICATIONS:** 

* BA/BS degree preferred in Industrial / Operations Management, Engineering or Business.
* 5+ years of manufacturing and leadership experience, Production Manager experience a plus.
* Knowledge of production processes, raw materials, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.
* Demonstrated success in driving operational performance, implementing process improvements, and achieving production targets.
* Results driven, analytical, self-motivated and detail oriented with the ability to logically identify alternative solutions or approaches to complex problems.
* Demonstrated presentation skills, as this role will be interfacing with executive level management, along with large customers.
* Effective team building and demonstrated leadership skills.
* Effective communication skills (written and verbal) with all levels in the organization.
* Must demonstrate proficient computer skills with Microsoft Office Suite.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** 

* Prioritize Employee Safety and Safety Compliance
* Oversee all plant operations to ensure effective production processes and meet production targets.
* Implement operational strategies, plans, and policies to optimize production efficiency, reduce costs, and improve quality.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions as needed to achieve performance goals.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of production supervisors, maintenance personnel, operators, and support staff.
* Establish clear performance expectations, provide feedback and recognition, and address performance issues promptly.
* Foster a positive work culture that promotes teamwork, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with production planning and scheduling team to develop production plans and schedules that meet customer requirements and optimize resource utilization.
* Monitor production progress, identify bottlenecks, and take proactive measures to ensure on-time delivery of products.
* Implement and maintain robust quality systems to ensure adherence to SQF, product specifications and customer requirements.
* Ensure effective asset-care and maintenance systems are in place to improve equipment reliability, execute preventive maintenance, reduce recurring downtime, manage critical spares and deliver planned maintenance outages safely and effectively.
* Participate in designing and implementing continuous improvement processes.
* Strong technical skills required.
* Strong organizational skills with ability to handle multiple tasks.
* Provide feedback up and down the organization.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT CONDITIONS SUBJECTED TO IN THIS POSITION:** 

* Inside, protected from weather
* Temperature controlled
* Subject to noise, moving machinery, and/or electrical currents
* Possible exposure to some chemicals, gases, high heat
* Subject to unregulated atmospheric conditions caused by odors, and dusts

existing_roles.title: Plant Manager
existing_roles.description:
Permian Enterprises Ltd. is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Plant Manager** to oversee daily plant operations and lead our production team. The Plant Manager is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting production goals, maintaining quality standards, and delivering excellent customer service.

This individual will provide strong leadership, establish operational priorities, develop employees, and ensure all plant activities align with company policies, procedures, and performance expectations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong decision-making skills, a commitment to workplace safety, and the ability to build a productive, accountable, and positive team culture.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Oversee and coordinate all daily plant operations to ensure production goals and deadlines are consistently met.
* Establish production schedules, determine priorities, and allocate resources to maximize operational efficiency.
* Monitor production performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions to increase productivity.
* Ensure all work is completed in accordance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and company procedures.
* Coordinate activities across departments and multiple operational entities to maintain smooth and efficient workflows.
* Manage equipment, materials, labor, and other resources effectively.

**Leadership & Employee Management**

* Provide direction, supervision, and support to plant employees and supervisory personnel.
* Assign responsibilities, delegate tasks, and establish clear performance expectations.
* Hold employees accountable for performance, attendance, productivity, and adherence to company policies.
* Address employee concerns and workplace issues professionally, consistently, and in a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain a positive workplace culture built on teamwork, communication, respect, and accountability.
* Identify training needs and support employee development and growth.

**Safety & Quality Control**

* Promote a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with all company safety policies and procedures.
* Ensure employees are properly trained and follow required safety practices.
* Monitor quality control processes to ensure products and services meet company and customer expectations.
* Identify operational risks, address safety concerns, and take corrective action when necessary.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and professional plant environment.

**Communication & Performance**

* Communicate effectively with upper management, supervisors, employees, and customers as needed.
* Provide regular updates regarding production performance, staffing, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities.
* Make timely decisions and resolve operational issues with sound judgment.
* Balance multiple priorities while maintaining focus on company objectives and deadlines.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of **2 years of management experience** in an oilfield plant or production plant environment preferred.
* Experience with coating and sandblasting operations preferred.
* Strong leadership and employee management skills, with demonstrated experience handling employee relations and maintaining a positive workplace culture.
* Excellent critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to interpret complex situations and communicate expectations and solutions effectively.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and delegate responsibilities.
* Self-motivated, dependable, and capable of working independently with limited oversight.
* Proficient in English, including reading and writing.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
* Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record required.

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Salary:** Up to $115,000 per year, based on qualifications and experience.

**Required Experience**

* Production Plant Management: Minimum 2 years
* Oilfield Management: Minimum 2 years

**Language**

* English: Required
* Spanish: Preferred

**Work Environment**

* Full-time, in-person position.
* Requires a hands-on leadership presence within the plant and the ability to oversee daily operational activities.

**Permian Enterprises Ltd. is committed to maintaining a safe, productive, and respectful workplace while delivering quality service to our customers.**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Up to $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* production plant management: 2 years (Required)
* oilfield management: 2 years (Required)

* Spanish (Preferred)

existing_roles.description:
Overview:

**WHO WE ARE**

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes. 
 
Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

**TOTAL REWARDS**

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

Expected salary range of $189,000 to $210,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k).

Responsibilities:

**PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION**

Manage and oversee the safe, efficient and reliable operation of fossil or hydro station(s). Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements, applicable industry technical standards and company policies. Operate the plant(s) in a manner that minimizes the cost of generation and maximizes profitability while maintaining the long-term viability of the station assets.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

 

* Ensure standards are established and implemented to provide a safe work environment.
* Effectively manage all resources to ensure generation of electricity in a timely and reliable manner at the direction of the Power Team.
* Maintain a positive work environment and good employee relations. Provide guidance for employee development opportunities and timely feedback regarding performance.
* Serve as a change agent for business initiatives, while assuring the human element is understood and considered
* Manage the station O&M and capital budgets to minimize costs and maximize profitability while ensuring the long-term viability of the assets.
* Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements and maintain environmental stewardship.
* Maintain effective community relations to promote a positive image of the Company.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

 

* BS in engineering or business
* Minimum of 10 years professional experience
* Minimum of 8 years power plant (or related) experience
* Minimum of 5 years supervisory/managerial experience
* Professional or technical level experience in a technical role at a power plant
* Operations
* At least 2 of the following: Corporate/Staff, Engineering, Maintenance, or Outage
* Leadership assessment required

 
Qualifications:

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

 

* Master's Degree in engineering, business or related field
* Multi-site experience
* Multi-departmental experience
* Collective bargaining experience

Description:

Davis Furniture is a family-owned high-end furniture manufacturer who is a leader in contemporary contract furniture. We have been in business for over 80 years, and we put a strong focus on new product introductions because design is a choice. Business at Davis is thriving! We are currently looking to hire a new Plant Manager for one of our plants.

Requirements:

The Plant Manager is the primary resource for all plant functions in area of responsibility. Manages both supervisors and hourly employees; and interacts with support personnel to ensure all established key metrics are achieved. Responsible for ensuring all company policy and procedures are followed, driving continuous improvement initiatives, enforcing safety policies and procedures, and ensuring that quality is maintained to Davis and customer standards.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee all manufacturing processes
* Ensure production schedules, output goals, and quality standards are consistently met
* Monitor workflow, labor utilization, and process efficiency
* Identify and resolve production issues while driving continuous improvement initiatives
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors and department managers
* Manage hiring, training, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and engagement
* Enforce safety policies and ensure OSHA compliance
* Lead safety initiatives to reduce workplace incidents
* Ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements
* Manage labor, materials, and operational costs
* Track and analyze key performance metrics (efficiency, scrap, downtime, throughput)
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and improve overall plant performance
* Oversee preventative maintenance and equipment reliability
* Coordinate repairs and capital improvements
* Partner with purchasing and planning to maintain proper inventory levels and ensure material availability
* Other duties may be added as required\*

**Education/Experience**

* Must be 18 years of age
* Associate's or Bachelor's in Operations Management, Industrial Technology, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of five years of manufacturing leadership experience, preferably in furniture, upholstery, textile, or related manufacturing environments.
* Previous experience managing sewing, cutting, upholstery, or similar production operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supervisors and production employees.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, production scheduling, labor management, and quality control.
* Understanding of fabric handling, cutting methods, patterns, sewing operations, and material utilization.
* Experience with production metrics, cost management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to make operational decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Benefits:**

Weekly pay

401(k)

Profit Sharing

Excellent health insurance with low deductible

Dental and vision plans

Voluntary and Company paid Life insurance

Short term/Long-term disability

Referral program

Paid holidays

On-site Clinic

Schedule:

This is a first shift salaried position; you will work Monday-Friday and Saturdays as needed.

Davis provides an excellent, drug free working environment and is an EEO/AA employer.

Please visit our website for more insight into our company and the products we create. www.davisfurniture.com

existing_roles.description:
**Work Location: Newington, CT. This is an in person role, not remote, not hybrid**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Work Schedule: Monday - Friday; 8:30 am - 5:00 pm**

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, management, and performance of the Data-Graphics manufacturing facility. This position directs all aspects of plant operations, including production, quality, safety, maintenance, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Plant Manager ensures production commitments are met while maintaining high quality standards, maximizing operational efficiency, controlling costs, and fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and safety.

The Plant Manager provides strategic and hands-on leadership to achieve key performance indicators (KPIs), customer satisfaction goals, employee engagement objectives, and business growth initiatives.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
=========================================

**Operations Management**

* Direct and oversee all day-to-day plant operations, including production, scheduling, quality, safety, maintenance and receiving activities.
* Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining quality standards, delivery commitments, and operational efficiency.
* Develop, monitor, and achieve plant performance metrics related to productivity, quality, waste reduction, safety, downtime, labor utilization, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with sales, customer service, prepress, and production teams to ensure customer expectations are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establish priorities and allocate resources to support production requirements and business objectives.
* Analyze operational performance and implement corrective actions as needed to improve productivity and profitability.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, and production personnel to maximize performance and engagement.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, teamwork, professionalism, and employee development.
* Conduct performance evaluations, establish performance expectations, and provide ongoing coaching and feedback.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee relations matters, recruitment, retention, performance management, and disciplinary actions.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate training and development opportunities to support operational excellence.

**Quality Management**

* Champion quality initiatives to ensure products consistently meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
* Investigate quality concerns and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Monitor production processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and defect reduction.
* Work closely with client services and suppliers to address quality-related concerns and maintain strong business relationships.

**Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all company safety policies, environmental regulations, and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Promote and maintain a safe work environment through training, audits, inspections, and corrective actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and support accident investigation and root cause analysis activities.
* Ensure appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is utilized and safety procedures are consistently followed.

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee preventive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, waste reduction, and cost-saving initiatives throughout the facility.
* Evaluate equipment, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for increased efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve throughput, reduce spoilage, and optimize labor utilization.

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operational expenses.
* Monitor labor costs, production costs, and capital expenditures to ensure financial targets are achieved.
* Participate in forecasting, strategic planning, and capital investment decisions affecting the facility.

**Communication & Reporting**

* Communicate operational results, goals, and key initiatives to leadership and employees.
* Prepare and present reports on plant performance, production metrics, quality trends, safety performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Keep executive management informed of significant operational issues, risks, and opportunities.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of company objectives.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience overseeing production operations and employees.
* Printing, packaging, direct mail, graphic communications, or related manufacturing industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.
* Experience managing budgets, KPIs, production planning, and quality systems.

**COMPETENCIES**

**Leadership**

* Strong leadership and team-building abilities
* Ability to motivate and develop employees at all levels
* Effective coaching, mentoring, and performance management skills
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities

**Operational Excellence**

* Knowledge of manufacturing operations and process improvement methodologies
* Understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles
* Experience utilizing production metrics and KPIs to drive results
* Strong project management and organizational skills

**Technical Knowledge**

* Knowledge of printing operations, lithographic printing, flexographic printing, finishing, and mailing operations preferred
* Understanding of quality management systems and root cause analysis techniques
* Knowledge of maintenance planning and equipment reliability principles

**Communication & Business Skills**

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong analytical and financial acumen
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook
* Ability to effectively manage customer, vendor, and employee relationships

The plant manager is responsible to operate the Pacific Plant consistent with company goals for cost, quality, service, regulatory compliance, safety, labor relations, and housekeeping. Function as a consultant for other plants and corporate.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze Daily, Weekly, and Monthly performance data (cost, production, quality, safety, service, and human relations) and work with department heads to optimize plant performance.
* Spend time in the plant reviewing the operation, speaking with associates, answering questions, soliciting for improvement ideas, reinforcing policy and procedures, etc.
* Train and coach department heads and Supervisors in problem solving, priority setting, goal setting, Confrontation/Communication skills, Labor Relations, etc.
* Complete required reports for Corporate, State and Federal agencies. Maintain PSM standards.
* Optimize safety performance, including daily tours through the plant, review of all accident reports, conducting safety meetings, one to one discussion with associates, review of safety infractions/discipline, and housekeeping tours.
* Collaborate with R&D and Marketing to assure manufacturing capabilities align with product innovation launches.
* Miscellaneous administrative work regarding phone calls, forecasting, audits, capital projects, wage proposals, collaboration meetings etc.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 7 years of experience managing a plant
* Very strong verbal communication skills, ability to effectively communicate one-on-one and present to large group.
* Strong written communication skills: ability to effectively communicate with customers by email, as well as develop written reports and presentations.
* High proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, SAP experience is a plus.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and analytical skills
* Experienced in Project Management and statistics.
Familiarity with DAP products a plus 

**About DAP**

DAP is a market leading manufacturer, innovator and marketer of home repair and construction products including caulks, sealants, spray foam insulation, adhesives, and patch and repair products. DAP is part of RPM International Inc., a $7.3 billion, multinational company with subsidiaries that are world leaders in specialty coatings, sealants, building materials and related services.

You will find DAP products in the hands of professional painters, remodelers, builders, and do-it-yourselfers, and in 60,000 retail outlets, ranging from home centers and mass merchandisers to your local hardware, pro contractor channels and paint stores. DAP's eight manufacturing and distribution facilities in the United States of America and Canada service North America and the world.

At DAP, we hire the best people and give them a collaborative and rewarding work environment that empowers them to succeed! We support associates in continuous professional growth and collaborate on the steps it takes to get to the next level in their careers. Our associates enjoy a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k) with company match, pension, paid parental leave, competitive health insurance rates, employee stock purchase plan, tuition reimbursement, free wellness programs and more! Learn more about DAP’s history, culture and benefits at www.dap.com/careers/

existing_roles.title: Director - Digital Operations, Manufacturing Execution
existing_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

GE Aerospace is seeking a Director – Digital Operations, Manufacturing Execution to lead ongoing digital operations across our Manufacturing Execution ecosystem. This role is responsible for platform stewardship, operational support, service continuity, and steady-state ownership of critical manufacturing applications that enable factory performance across the enterprise.
 
 
The Director will provide cross-functional leadership across support, product, and architecture to ensure reliable, scalable, and well-governed operations for platforms including PlantApps, PFMD, Bluestreak, and the broader future digital manufacturing ecosystem. This leader will own the operating model for sustaining and improving these platforms over time, with accountability for uptime, service performance, support responsiveness, operational stability, platform health, and issue resolution.
 
 
This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can operate effectively across a complex enterprise, align multiple stakeholders, and build a durable future-state operating model for manufacturing digital operations. 
 
\*Eastern Time Zone Preferred for US Based Candidates\*

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**:

In this role, you will:

* Lead the digital operations function for Manufacturing Execution, with accountability for ongoing support, operational continuity, service performance, and platform stewardship.
* Provide continuous, steady-state ownership across a portfolio of manufacturing digital platforms, including PlantApps, PFMD, Bluestreak, and related applications in the future digital manufacturing ecosystem.
* Lead cross-functional teams spanning operations, support, product, and architecture to ensure stable and effective operation of business-critical manufacturing platforms.
* Establish and manage the support model, operating model, service governance, and platform ownership structure required to sustain and improve MES-related platforms.
* Drive uptime, operational stability, support responsiveness, platform health, and issue resolution across the ecosystem.
* Partner with operations teams, product owners, architects, support teams, and site users to ensure services are reliable, well-governed, and aligned to business needs.
* Govern service delivery through clear KPIs, operating cadences, escalation paths, and performance reporting.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement efforts to reduce repeat issues and strengthen operational reliability.
* Ensure operational readiness and service continuity for releases, upgrades, migrations, implementations, and platform transitions.
* Prioritize investment and attention across support needs, service risks, platform health, and business-critical operational demands.
* Drive adherence to compliance, controls, and cybersecurity requirements while simplifying and strengthening operational processes.
* Build and lead a culture grounded in FLIGHT DECK, with strong focus on respect for people, continuous improvement, customer value, and accountability.
* Shape and optimize a durable future-state operating model for enterprise manufacturing digital operations.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

 

* Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 11 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 13 years of professional experience
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Digital Operations.
* Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience
* Eligibility Requirement:
* Legal authorization to work in the U.S. or UK is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

**Desired Characteristics:**

**Technical and Business Expertise:**

* Strong experience leading digital operations, service delivery, application support, or platform operations in a complex enterprise environment
* Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing applications, or other business-critical digital platforms
* Demonstrated success operating and improving platforms with accountability for service continuity, uptime, support responsiveness, and operational stability
* Experience working across multiple platforms and stakeholder groups to create effective operating models and governance structures
* Strong understanding of service management, incident/problem management, release readiness, operational controls, and platform lifecycle support
* Ability to make tradeoffs across platform health, support demand, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Familiarity with digital manufacturing environments and the role of technology in supporting safety, quality, delivery, and cost

**Leadership:**

* Demonstrated success leading enterprise or multi-platform operational ownership with broad cross-functional leadership
* Experience leading support, product, architecture, and engineering in a matrixed global organization
* Ability to create clarity in complex environments and align teams around a common operating model
* Strong judgment in prioritization, escalation management, governance, and service ownership decisions
* Experience coaching, developing, and optimizing teams in support of long-term organizational capability

**Personal Attributes:**

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage senior leaders and technical teams with confidence and clarity
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into a durable operating model and concrete action plans
* Strong analytical, organizational, and execution skills
* Comfortable working through ambiguity, scale, and organizational complexity
* Customer-focused and operationally disciplined, with a strong bias for action and continuous improvement

**Additional Information for candidates in US:**

The base pay range for this position is $152,000-$202,000 USD. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 10th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

**For Candidates in the UK:**

At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible. As a new joiner to GE we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs;

 

* Non-contributory Pension
* Bonus
* Car allowance
* Life Assurance
* Group income protection
* Private medical cover
* Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible option to buy or sell

Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance is required and must be maintained for this role. Please note that in the event that BPSS clearance cannot be obtained, you may not be eligible for the role and/or any offer of employment may be withdrawn on grounds of national security. Please see the link below for further details regarding the requirements for BPSS clearance: BPSS

Applications from job seekers who require sponsorship to work in the UK are welcome and will be considered alongside all other applications. However, under the applicable UK immigration rules as may be in place from time to time, it may be that candidates who do not currently have the right to work in the UK may not be appointed to a post if a suitably qualified, experienced and skilled candidate who does not require sponsorship is available to take up the post. For further information please visit the UK Visas and Immigration website.

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

existing_roles.title: Director, Balance of Plant
existing_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world's transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people's quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

**Job Summary**

Kairos Power is seeking an experienced senior engineering leader to serve as Director, Balance of Plant (Power Generation System & Turbine Island), to provide strategic and technical leadership for multidisciplinary engineering teams. This role is responsible for the technical leadership, organizational capability, and execution of the engineering teams responsible for design and deployment for Structures, Systems, and Components that convert thermal energy to electricity and provide auxiliary plant functions necessary to support reliable and efficient plant operation. The ideal candidate combines broad power plant and thermal-fluid systems expertise with demonstrated success building engineering teams, working with external partners, and delivering complex, hardware systems from concept through commissioning and operation.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership for the development and integration of balance-of-plant (BOP) Systems, such as the Heat Transport Systems interfacing with high-temperature steam Rankine cycles, Power Generation System (PGS), and auxiliary systems such as service water, treated water, and compressed air systems.
* Establish department technical direction and decision boundaries consistent with company strategy and designated technical authorities.
* Lead engineering delivery from conceptual sizing through detailed design, vendor package review, and commissioning support, owning design reviews and technical risk.
* Ensures that system and discipline leads satisfy applicable requirements, codes and standards, safety functions,and align to program
* Ensure engineering deliverables—including requirements, calculations, analyses, specifications, drawings, design reports, interface documents, and test plans—are technically sound and meet established quality and schedule requirements.
* Oversee supplier technical execution, including supplier selection, bid evaluations, equipment specifications, design reviews, technical evaluations, qualification programs, factory acceptance testing, and resolution of supplier technical issues, to ensure supplier designs and deliverables meet Kairos Power requirements.
* Oversee evaluation of BOP design and supplier changes for impacts on system interfaces, plant performance, safety, and commissioning readiness, and ensure approved changes are incorporated into the controlled technical baseline.
* Build productive relationships with external organizations while maintaining clear accountability for Kairos Power technical requirements and engineering decisions.
* Translates company strategy into measurable organizational priorities and decision principles.
* Determine and communicate explicit scope, schedule, risk, and resource tradeoffs across the organization.
* Maintain accountability for organizational outcomes and the consequences of scope, schedule, risk, and resource decisions within delegated authority, including decisions delegated to others.
* Ensure execution of strategic priorities, take corrective action when results are off track, and remove systemic barriers teams cannot resolve.
* Establish organizational technical direction and decision boundaries are established, consistent with company strategy and designated technical authorities.
* Ensure material technical and safety risk, their potential consequences, and proposed mitigations are clearly documented and communicated to the appropriate authority, with risk acceptance decisions explicitly recorded.
* Personally engage in mission-critical technical or organizational decisions, crises, external reviews, or critical deliverables when judgment materially changes the outcome.
* Build the organization and leadership pipeline required for current and future strategy, including recruitment, staffing, and leadership development.
* Hold senior leaders and technical leads accountable for team capability, succession, performance, engagement, and retention.
* Ensure systemic operational or compliance weaknesses are corrected and that improvements are sustained across the organization.
* Communicate organizational direction and tradeoffs consistently to leadership, teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Establish alignment across teams, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and escalate tradeoffs that require broader leadership decisions.
* Set the organizational tone for accountability, integrity, psychological safety, and mission stewardship, and reinforce these values through visible decisions, resource choices, recognition, and corrective action.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent
* 15+ years of progressively responsible engineering experience involving power generation, thermal-fluid systems, process systems, nuclear systems, or other complex industrial systems.
* 7+years of progressive engineering leadership experience managing engineering teams with multiple engineering disciplines.
* Experience managing engineering managers or technical leads with accountability for outcomes across multiple teams and work sites.
* Experience working with suppliers, OEMs, engineering contractors, or other external technical organizations.
* Experience leading technical development and qualification of major equipment through external suppliers or OEMs.
* Experience supporting construction, commissioning, startup, or operation of complex power generation or industrial facilities.
* Experience with integrated power plant systems, including modern high-temperature steam Rankine cycles and the interactions between heat transport, power conversion, auxiliary systems, and plant infrastructure.
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to identify and resolve technical issues that cross traditional engineering and organizational boundaries.
* Lead and support recruitment and staffing requirements of group.
* Proactive, organized, adaptable, and able to thrive in fast-paced, multi-tasked environments.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Knowledge of integrated power plant architecture, thermal-fluid systems, power generation systems, auxiliary systems, major plant equipment, and their interfaces, including familiarity with various steam generator technologies such as Heat Recovery Steam Generators and molten salt steam generators.
* Knowledge of equipment procurement, supplier engineering, manufacturing, testing, installation, commissioning, and lifecycle considerations associated with complex industrial systems.
* Skill in leading and developing multidisciplinary engineering organizations and holding teams accountable for technical and execution outcomes.
* Skill in translating program objectives into engineering strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable commitments.
* Skill in technical decision-making, trade studies, risk assessment, problem solving, and resolution of complex cross-system issues.
* Ability to establish clear accountability while empowering managers, technical leads, and responsible engineers to make decisions at the appropriate organizational level.
* Ability to operate effectively in a first-of-a-kind environment characterized by technical uncertainty, evolving requirements, and competing priorities.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues, uncertainties, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders to support informed decisions.

**Physical Demands**

* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods
* Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another
* Repetitive assembly operations of manufacturing test fixtures and test setups in collaboration with engineering and manufacturing teams
* Communicating with others to exchange information

**Environmental Conditions**

* General office environment
* Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned
* High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced
* Prototyping/Test Environments
* Manufacturing/Industrial Environments

**Safety and PPE**

* Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs
* Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions
* Wearing proper personal protective equipment (PPE), to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes, and other PPE as required

**Travel**

* Some travel may be required (up to 25%)

**Additional Requirements**

* Occasionally requires working weekends
* Occasionally requires schedule flexibility
* Occasionally requires extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines

#LI-Remote

**About our Benefits**

We know that we have some of the most talented and dedicated employees, and we believe in rewarding them accordingly. If you work here, full-time employees (excludes interns) expect to have access to the benefits below:

* Competitive compensation packages
* Medical, dental and vision benefits for employees and their dependents
* Paid Vacation
* 401(k) and pre-tax health insurance, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA)

Kairos Power is committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities where we do business. Kairos Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We actively welcome people of different experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Kairos Power participates in E-Verify.

Candidates only, no recruiters or agencies please.

Note: You are applying for a position that is located in a facility that handles information that is subject to export control restrictions by the Department of Energy under 10 CFR Part 810. To work in this facility, you need to be authorized by the Department of Energy to access Part 810-controlled information. Foreign nationals who are citizens of countries that are not on the Department of Energy's general authorization list (link below) are not permitted to work in our facility unless the Department of Energy issues an export control license to the company to permit that individual to have access to Part 810-controlled information. The following questions are intended to determine the licensing requirements that may apply. https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/10/appendix-A\_to\_part\_810

existing_roles.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with **neffy®**, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you're motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

 

The Manager / Sr. Manager, Technical Operations will play a key role in executing Technical Operations programs that support the continued development and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment, project management, and external partner leadership in a highly collaborative environment.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and CMOs, this role provides technical and operational leadership across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Responsibilities include leading Technical Operations projects, supporting formulation and process development, technology transfer, GMP manufacturing activities, and resolution of technical and operational issues. The position ensures project scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and budgets remain aligned while proactively identifying and escalating risks to support compliant, reliable, and on-time product supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage cross-functional Technical Operations projects and day-to-day technical and operational interactions with assigned external partners, including scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, key milestones, project meetings, action tracking, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, and CMO/vendor performance metrics and KPIs (e.g., service, quality, delivery, capacity, and right-first-time).
* Serve as a Technical Operations point of contact for assigned external manufacturing partners and work closely with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure execution against agreed project plans and supply requirements.
* Provide technical oversight of formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, and continued process verification activities, as applicable.
* Plan and support clinical and commercial manufacturing campaigns in coordination with CMOs, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and other internal functions; provide on-site/person-in-plant support for key manufacturing activities as needed.
* Review manufacturing and process documentation, including master and executed batch records, protocols, reports, process performance data, vendor change controls, investigations, and annual/product reviews, for technical accuracy and process performance.
* Lead or support technical assessment and resolution of manufacturing deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and other process issues; contribute to root-cause analysis and appropriate corrective and preventive actions in partnership with Quality Assurance.
* Assess proposed manufacturing and process changes for technical impact and support cross-functional evaluation of quality, supply, and regulatory implications.
* Monitor and trend manufacturing and process performance data to identify emerging risks, process drift, and opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Support vendor selection, onboarding, and qualification activities in collaboration with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate project status, technical risks, manufacturing issues, and recommend actions clearly to Technical Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders; escalate significant issues to appropriate decision-makers.
* Support preparation and review of CMC information for regulatory submissions and responses to health authority questions, as required.
* Support Technical Operations process improvement, business continuity, capacity planning, and other strategic operational initiatives as assigned.
* Support commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including coordination with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, distribution partners, and external manufacturing/packaging partners to maintain reliable product supply.
* Support product serialization activities, including EPCIS data exchange and operational compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements, working with packaging, distribution, Quality Assurance, and other partners as appropriate.
* Support clinical supply activities, including coordination with Clinical Operations and external vendors for clinical packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities, as applicable.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, and applicable quality systems and regulatory expectations.
* Demonstrated technical understanding of formulation, manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, and process performance sufficient to critically evaluate CMO data and recommendations, work effectively in cross-functional technical teams, and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
* Strong project and vendor management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, deliverables, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex manufacturing or process issues, develop recommendations, and communicate the rationale for action.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across functions and organizational levels, including senior management and external partners.
* Well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to identify and escalate risks while maintaining focus on execution and business priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project/reporting tools; experience with project management, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies is a plus.
* Working knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations relevant to Technical Operations, including 3PL interfaces, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA requirements, and clinical IRT/IWRS processes; direct experience in one or more of these areas is preferred.
* Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 20% to support external manufacturing partners and key project activities.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or a related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree is a plus. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process/formulation development, CMC, supply chain, or a related function.
* Experience working with external CMOs/CDMOs and supporting GMP clinical and/or commercial manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, commercial product launch, or PPQ is preferred.
* Experience reviewing manufacturing batch records and process documentation and supporting technical investigations, change controls, and regulatory CMC activities is preferred.
* Experience supporting commercial distribution/3PL operations, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and/or clinical supply and IRT/IWRS activities is preferred.

At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.

Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

existing_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Flight Coordination Quality & Tr
existing_roles.description:
**Title Options:** Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager

**Location:** Remote, US

**Reports to:** VP of Flight Coordination

**Hours:** Monday – Friday 8:30 am – 5:30 pm

**Position Summary**

The **Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager** represents a quality-control and workforce-development function similar to those found in high-performing contact centers and service-delivery organizations. The role ensures every incoming lead, whether received by phone, web form, chat, or referral, is responded to promptly, handled consistently, accurately qualified, fully documented, and advanced through the appropriate next step. Through quality assurance, coaching, training, performance analytics, workflow oversight, and cross-functional coordination, this role strengthens Flight Coordinator performance while protecting the patient and partner experience from first contact through flight execution

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for continuously reviewing lead interactions, identifying performance and process gaps, and translating findings into targeted coaching, training, and development initiatives. The individual reviews call recordings, chats, web submissions, referral activity, CRM records, follow-up activity, and department handoffs to identify quality risks before they affect a patient, referring facility, payer, partner, or flight outcome.

**How this role impacts our mission**

Every day, families, healthcare providers, and case managers rely on our team to help navigate complex situations and coordinate critical air medical transportation. As the nation's largest fixed-wing air ambulance operator, our mission is to make those moments easier through compassionate, expert air medical transportation, connecting patients with the care they need and getting them to that destination.

The Flight Coordination team is often the first point of contact, serving as a trusted guide through a time-sensitive and highly emotional process. As the FC Quality & Training Manager, you will strengthen team performance through coaching, training, quality oversight, and continuous improvement – helping Flight Coordinators build the skills and confidence to deliver compassionate, accurate, and professional service while advancing opportunities efficiently and supporting patients throughout their journey.

This is an opportunity to shape the experience of both our team members and the families we serve. By improving quality, readiness, and operational consistency, you will help ensure that every patient, provider, and referral partner receives the highest level of care and support throughout their journey.

**Core ownership**

Own quality control across every inbound lead channel and protect forward movement through two distinct stages: (1) incoming lead to qualified opportunity and (2) active opportunity to completed flight or a fully documented, supportable lost outcome.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**1. Intake Quality & Opportunity Readiness**

* Monitor incoming inquiry channels, queues, assignment, and response times to ensure every viable inquiry is acknowledged and actively worked within established service expectations.
* Review calls and transcripts for discovery, active listening, empathy, urgency recognition, value communication, objection handling, qualification, closing language, and clear next steps.
* Audit whether Flight Coordinators appropriately advance, nurture, close, or disqualify inquiries.

* Review inquiries marked false, invalid, duplicate, unqualified, or closed-lost. Challenge, reopen, or escalate records when the disposition is unsupported or a viable opportunity may have been missed.
* Identify conversion and process gaps by coordinator, source, payer type, referral source, service type, call scenario, shift, and funnel stage.
* Maintain a standardized intake-quality scorecard and documented expectations for what strong performance looks like.

**2. Flight Readiness & Coordination Oversight**

* Serves as a cross-departmental liaison with Clinical Operations and Revenue Cycle Management to confirm required clinical reviews, financial clearance, authorizations, documentation, and follow-through are progressing on time and that each opportunity is fully prepared to fly.
* Monitor active opportunities until they become completed flights or reach a documented and supportable lost outcome.
* Confirm each opportunity has a clear next action, responsible owner, due date, and follow-up plan.
* Audit records for required patient, clinical, financial, facility, authorization, payer, transportation, logistics, and operational information.
* Identify aging, stalled, inactive, or incomplete opportunities and intervene before the flight is delayed or lost.
* Ensure follow-up continues after an inquiry is advanced to an opportunity and that ownership does not stop at the initial commitment.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.

**Quality Review, Coaching & Development**

* Establish and maintain a consistent review methodology across inbound calls, outbound follow-up, quote conversations, high-urgency inquiries, lost-flight interactions, and other priority scenarios.
* Conduct recurring one-on-one coaching using specific examples from calls, transcripts, records, and workflow activity.
* Create documented coaching plans with clear behaviors, actions, due dates, and follow-up review.
* Recognize strong performance and share repeatable best practices across the team.
* Measure whether coaching produces sustained improvement and escalate recurring quality or workflow concerns to Flight Coordination leadership.
* Partner with leaders on focused development plans when additional support or accountability is needed.

**4. Training & Team Readiness**

* Translate quality findings into targeted training, refreshers, job aids, talk tracks, checklists, and scenario-based exercises.

* Identify recurring themes that require team-wide training rather than individual coaching.
* Coordinate subject-matter input from Revenue Cycle Management, Clinical Operations, Logistics, and other operational partners.
* Maintain current process guidance and a centralized source of truth for Flight Coordination expectations.
* Support new-hire onboarding, readiness reviews, and ongoing proficiency checks.
* Track training completion, understanding, and sustained application on the job.

**5. Cross-Functional Handoff Quality**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Flight Coordination and departments receiving or supporting active opportunities.
* Establish clear handoff reuirements, ownership expectations, and acceptance criteria with partner departments.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.

existing_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality Control
existing_roles.description:
ElevateBio is a technology-driven company powering the industry forward by helping partners realize the potential of their therapies from design to commercialization. We have integrated a differentiated set of technologies, end-to-end services, and industry-leading manufacturing expertise to develop advanced therapies faster and more efficiently.

 

**The Role**

The Senior Director, Quality Control leads all Quality Control operations at ElevateBio's Waltham site, including QC Analytical Technologies (QCAT), QC Analytics, Testing Core, QC Microbiology, QC Raw Materials, and QC Logistics. The role is accountable for safe, compliant, inspection-ready, and predictable execution across a seven-day operating model, including product release and in-process testing, STAT support to Manufacturing, environmental and microbiological testing, raw material disposition, stability support, sample management, and analytical lifecycle enablement. The Senior Director establishes the QC operating strategy, capacity and resource plan, performance system, and leadership model required to meet manufacturing, client, and business commitments while sustaining laboratory excellence and data integrity.

**Here's What You'll Do**

**QC Strategy and Leadership**

* Lead the integrated QC organization, operating model, objectives, decision rights, talent strategy, and capability roadmap.
* Develop QC management and technical leaders while aligning headcount, seven-day coverage, facilities, equipment, systems, operating expense, and capital with demand.

**Predictable QC Operations and Laboratory Excellence**

* Own safe, compliant, and predictable execution of product release and in-process testing, environmental and microbiological monitoring, raw material disposition, stability, sample management, and client commitments.
* Ensure reliable seven-day operations through capacity planning, schedule control, tiered daily management, performance review, and timely escalation and recovery.
* Partner with Manufacturing to align readiness, prioritization, and rapid execution of STAT in-process samples within required decision windows.
* Drive laboratory excellence through standard work, right-first-time execution, efficient review and reporting, backlog control, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.

**Analytical Technologies and Lifecycle Enablement**

* Provide leadership oversight for QCAT, including client technical interface, technology and method transfer, qualification and validation, method lifecycle management, equipment qualification, controls and critical reagents, and Digital QC.
* Ensure effective utilization of shared QC Resources, handoffs between QCAT and operational laboratories through clear readiness criteria, accountability, sustainable capacity, and post-implementation monitoring.

**Quality, Compliance, and Partnership**

* Ensure QC activities meet cGMP, approved procedures, specifications, quality agreements, data-integrity expectations, and regulatory commitments.
* Provide senior oversight of laboratory events, atypical or out-of-specification results, deviations, investigations, CAPAs, changes, risks, and inspection readiness.
* Represent QC in client governance, audits, regulatory inspections, release-readiness reviews, and escalations; communicate performance, constraints, risks, and recovery plans clearly.
* Serve as the senior QC partner to Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Facilities & Engineering, MSAT, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Digital, Process and Analytical Development, and site leadership.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
* At least 15 years of progressive experience in GMP Quality Control or analytical laboratory operations, including substantial leadership of managers and multi-functional teams.
* Demonstrated leadership of a broad QC organization supporting complex biopharmaceutical, biologics, cell therapy, gene therapy, or other regulated manufacturing operations.
* Strong knowledge of GMP laboratory controls, analytical testing, microbiology, environmental monitoring, raw materials, stability, sample management, analytical lifecycle activities, laboratory systems, data integrity, contract laboratory oversight, and quality systems.
* Demonstrated success improving schedule reliability, turnaround time, right-first-time performance, capacity utilization, investigation management, and inspection readiness.
* Experience leading seven-day operations and partnering with Manufacturing on time-critical in-process testing and operational decision windows.
* Experience supporting client audits, regulatory inspections, client governance, and significant quality or delivery escalations.
* Strong strategic planning, financial stewardship, organizational design, talent development, communication, decision-making, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or demonstrated experience applying Lean Six Sigma, Lean Lab, and Digital Lab practices to improve laboratory flow, capacity, data visibility, and operational performance is preferred.
* Experience in a multi-program or CDMO environment is preferred.

**Physical and Environment Requirements:**

* Ability to stand, walk, bend and stretch for extended period of time
* Ability to lift 15-20 lbs
* Ability to push, pull, bend, kneel, twist and climb step ladders while wearing PPE.
* Ability to perform routine repetitive motions with use of arms, wrists and hands

 

*The budgeted range for this position is $240,000 - $330,000. This range is a good faith estimate of the expected salary range for this position, based on a wide range of factors including qualifications, experience and training, operational and business needs and other considerations permitted by law.*

ElevateBio will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.*
