protected_roles.title: Operations Director
protected_roles.description:
Gotion Inc. is based in Silicon Valley, CA, currently building a Manufacturing facility in Manteno, IL and has R&D centers in Ohio, China, Japan and Europe. We innovate in the next generation electric vehicle and energy storage technologies (lithium batteries and related systems) with the aim to accelerate electrified transportation and achieve sustainable development. Gotion is powered by a leading power battery technology company that provides solutions for vehicles including the world's first mass commercial e-bus route. 
 
Gotion is a career destination - we are not simply attempting to just fill another job, but to pursue a dream of global green energy together! We offer outstanding opportunities to individuals seeking an exciting and challenging working environment. Everyone is highly valued and plays a vital role in the growth of our organization.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Director is responsible for leading and coordinating key operational functions of the manufacturing facility, including **Production Planning, Supply Chain, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and Infrastructure/Construction Engineering**.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring production readiness, material availability, operational continuity, regulatory compliance, facility development, and cross-functional execution.

The Operations Director will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and other functional leaders to support safe, efficient, and scalable operations of the Chicago manufacturing facility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Operations Coordination**

* Lead production planning and scheduling based on demand, capacity, materials, and priorities.
* Develop and manage short- and long-term production plans.
* Coordinate manpower, equipment, and materials to achieve production targets.
* Monitor plan execution and identify delivery risks.
* Drive cross-functional efforts to resolve production and operational constraints.
* Track key KPIs, including production attainment, inventory, material availability, delivery, and efficiency.
* Support S&OP and capacity planning processes.

* **Supply Chain Management**

* Lead plant supply chain operations, including production planning, materials, procurement, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.
* Ensure material availability while maintaining optimal inventory levels.
* Improve inventory turnover and reduce excess and obsolete stock.
* Drive supplier performance and supply continuity.
* Identify supply chain risks and implement contingency plans.
* Manage domestic and international logistics activities.
* Lead continuous improvement in cost, efficiency, and delivery performance.

* **Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

* Lead the plant's EHS programs and team to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.
* Promote a strong safety culture and drive workplace safety initiatives.
* Oversee inspections, risk assessments, corrective actions, and emergency preparedness.
* Monitor EHS performance and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to improve safety and compliance.
* Support regulatory audits, inspections, and permitting activities.

* **Infrastructure & Construction Engineering**

* Lead facility engineering, infrastructure, and construction projects supporting plant operations.
* Oversee plant expansion, renovations, and infrastructure improvements.
* Manage contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Ensure projects meet scope, budget, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.
* Maintain critical facility systems, utilities, and infrastructure readiness.
* Support production line installation, commissioning, and facility startup activities.

* **Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Management**

* Establish and manage operational processes across planning, supply chain, EHS, and infrastructure.
* Lead operational reviews and drive action item completion.
* Identify and escalate operational risks to plant leadership.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, cost, delivery, inventory, and efficiency.
* Drive KPI-based decision-making and operational visibility.
* Support ERP/MRP and digitalization initiatives.
* Foster collaboration across Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, HR, and IT.

* **Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor managers and operational teams.
* Establish organizational structure, goals, and succession plans.
* Recruit, develop, and retain key talent.
* Drive performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a collaborative, safety-focused, high-performance culture.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* **10+ years of progressive experience** in manufacturing operations, supply chain, production planning, engineering, or related functions.
* **5+ years of leadership experience** managing managers and/or multiple operational functions.
* Strong experience in large-scale manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience in production planning, supply chain management, and plant operations.
* Working knowledge of EHS management and U.S. regulatory requirements.
* Experience supporting facility construction, plant expansion, infrastructure, or manufacturing engineering projects strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ERP/MRP systems; SAP experience preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **lithium-ion battery, EV, automotive, energy storage, electronics, or advanced manufacturing**.
* Experience supporting the launch or ramp-up of a new manufacturing facility in the United States.
* Experience managing complex global supply chains.
* Familiarity with high-volume automated manufacturing environments.
* Experience working with international and cross-cultural teams.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, S&OP, inventory optimization, and operational excellence methodologies.
* PMP, APICS/CPIM/CSCP, Six Sigma, or related professional certification is a plus.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Key performance measures may include:

**Production Planning:** Production Plan Attainment | Capacity Utilization | Schedule Adherence

**Supply Chain:** On-Time Delivery | Material Availability | Inventory Turns | Inventory Accuracy | Logistics Cost

**EHS:** Safety Incident Rate | Corrective Action Closure | Regulatory Compliance | Environmental Performance

**Infrastructure:** Project Schedule | Project Budget | Construction Safety | Facility Readiness | Utility Reliability

**Overall Operations:** Cost Reduction | Operational Efficiency | Risk Management | Cross-Functional Execution

**Leadership Scope**

The Operations Director provides leadership and management oversight for:

**Production Planning / PMC**

**Supply Chain & Logistics**

**Warehouse & Inventory**

**Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

**Infrastructure / Construction / Facility Engineering**

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000.00 –$240,000.00, plus eligibility for 20% bonus and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by factors such as the role, level, and geographic location. The range listed in the job posting represents the minimum and maximum target salaries for this position across all U.S. locations. Actual compensation within the range will be influenced by the specific work location, along with factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will provide more details about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed compensation reflects the base salary only and does not include bonus or benefits.

protected_roles.title: Director of Planning and Production Coordination
protected_roles.description:
**POSITION:** Director of Planning and Production Coordination

**SHIFT:** Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm + Additional hours based on business demand

**SALARY:** $139,362 - $155,161.50 + (DOE) + Full Benefits Package

**LOCATION: On-site in office in Fargo, ND**

### **SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Director of Planning and Production Coordination leads enterprise planning and production coordination across CSP, Tank and Structural product lines. The role establishes consistent planning standards, aligns demand with capacity, ensures production readiness, balances workloads across sites and supports reliable customer commitments. The role owns the planning system and coordination processes.

### **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Embrace and demonstrate the qualities of the TrueNorth Steel Game Changer definition.
* Comply with all safety, quality, environmental and workplace requirements.
* Lead, coach, and develop the CSP, Tank and Structural Planning Leaders and the Production Coordinator Supervisor, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and succession coverage.
* Establish and continuously improve an integrated planning and production-coordination system with common standards, planning horizons, terminology, decision rights, data requirements, and escalation paths.
* Align customer demand, forecasts, backlog, inventory, labor, equipment, material availability, and site capability into executable production plans.
* Confirm customer commit-date feasibility using verified readiness, material, capacity, outside-processing, site, and delivery information.
* Provide an enterprise view of capacity and constraints, leading approved workload-balancing actions such as site transfers, priority changes, outsourcing, overtime, and staffing adjustments.
* Define and enforce production-readiness requirements for drawings, bills of material, routing, material, CNC and nesting information, quality requirements, outside services, job packets, shipping information, and approvals.
* Lead regular site, product-line, and enterprise planning reviews that surface demand, capacity, backlog, readiness, schedule performance, risks, and decisions requiring action.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Sales, Project Management, Estimating, Drafting, Engineering, Purchasing, Inventory Control, Quality, Shipping, Logistics, Finance, and other functions to resolve planning constraints.
* Govern planning and production coordination data and transactions in SyteLine, Tekla and other approved systems, including capacity assumptions, work-center data, production status, and readiness information.
* Define performance measures and dashboards for schedule, backlog, capacity, readiness, equipment use, changes, and failure-related costs. Use data to improve delivery, throughput, material utilization, and profitability.
* Establish repeatable standard work, documentation, training, cross-training, and backup coverage to reduce dependence on individual knowledge.
* Serve as the escalation point for significant cross-site, cross-product, and cross-functional planning issues. Elevate unresolved matters with facts, alternatives, risks, and recommendations.
* Support annual business, capacity, capital, workforce, and budget planning, along with strategic manufacturing initiatives.
* Provide the VP of Manufacturing with regular updates on planning risks, delivery, capacity, material, organizational needs, trends, and recommended actions.
* Travel to manufacturing sites is required to understand processes, build relationships, support teams, and ensure consistent implementation of planning and production-coordination standards.
* Prompt and dependable attendance.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND QUALITIES**

* Strong knowledge of manufacturing planning, scheduling, capacity management, production coordination, inventory, and shop-floor execution.
* Ability to lead leaders and standardize planning processes across multiple manufacturing sites or business units.
* Working knowledge of ERP-supported planning, bills of material, routing, work centers, job release, inventory, and production transactions.
* Strong analytical judgment and ability to balance customer commitments, manufacturing capability, cost, and business risk.
* Effective communication, facilitation, change leadership and cross-functional influence skills.
* High integrity, accountability, attention to detail, sound judgment, and bias toward action.
* Commitment to safety, quality, customer service, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

### **EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, Construction Management or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Minimum of ten years of progressive responsible experience in manufacturing operations, planning, scheduling, supply chain, project coordination, or a related field preferred, including five years of leadership experience.
* Experience leading multi-site planning or operational processes, ERP-supported planning and cross-functional improvement preferred.
* Experience in steel fabrication, metal manufacturing, project-based manufacturing, or a related industrial environment preferred.

**About Blue Bird Corporation**

Blue Bird (NASDAQ: BLBD) is recognized as a technology leader and innovator of school buses since its founding in 1927. Our dedicated team members design, engineer and manufacture school buses with a singular focus on safety, reliability, and durability. School buses carry the most precious cargo in the world – 25 million children twice a day – making them the most trusted mode of student transportation. The company is the proven leader in low- and zero-emission school buses with more than 25,000 propane, natural gas, and electric powered buses sold. Blue Bird is transforming the student transportation industry through cleaner energy solutions. For more information on Blue Bird’s complete product and service portfolio, visit www.blue-bird.com (https://www.blue-bird.com/).

 

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Executive Director, Project Management, Industrialization will lead manufacturing and production readiness for the next-generation F53/F59 chassis platform, integrating Plan for Every Part (PFEP), continuous improvement (CI), Lean manufacturing, and operational excellence into the industrialization plan. This role will coordinate facilities, tooling, equipment, materials flow, process capability, quality systems, workforce readiness, and production ramp to support Q1 2028 production within approved budget, schedule, safety, and quality requirements.

This is a hands-on role accountable for personally developing and maintaining detailed project plans, resolving plant-level execution issues, and influencing action across functions without direct reports. Responsibilities extend beyond launch to sustaining PFEP, improving operating performance, and developing repeatable manufacturing and supply chain practices.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Industrialization and production readiness**

* Develop, document, and maintain the integrated industrialization plan, including milestones, dependencies, accountable owners, resource requirements, readiness criteria, and recovery actions.
* Drive production realization across facilities, tooling, equipment installation, line layout, manufacturing processes, quality readiness, staffing, training, materials management, and chassis shipping.
* Track capital milestones, budget commitments, capacity assumptions, process validation, and production ramp readiness; work with functional owners to close gaps and escalate decisions affecting launch.
* Work directly with plant teams to validate readiness on the production floor, resolve execution issues, and manage risks to safety, quality, cost, delivery, and business continuity.
* Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of PFEP with supply chain, materials, manufacturing engineering, and production teams, establishing data ownership and change controls that remain effective after launch.
* Ensure PFEP defines part requirements, supplier and lead-time information, packaging, storage locations, inventory parameters, replenishment methods, and point-of-use delivery requirements.
* Translate PFEP into practical receiving, storage, kitting, line-side delivery, and replenishment processes. Validate material availability and flow against production demand, space, handling, safety, and capacity requirements.
* Use PFEP data to identify and reduce shortages, excess inventory, unnecessary handling, and production interruptions; coordinate corrective actions with functional owners.
* Support the development of inbound and outbound logistics plans in collaboration with plant team members and third-party vendors, including delivery schedules, transportation capacity, staging, and finished chassis shipping, aligned with production demand and ramp requirements.

 

**Continuous improvement Lean and operational excellence**

* Develop and execute a prioritized CI and operational excellence roadmap that supports launch readiness and sustained performance after launch, with documented baselines, owners, milestones, and measurable benefits.
* Lead practical Lean initiatives, including value stream mapping, standard work, 5S, visual management, line balancing, and structured problem-solving to improve safety, quality, productivity, material flow, and delivery.
* Facilitate improvement events and coach plant teams in root-cause analysis and corrective action. Establish follow-up routines and measures to confirm improvements are adopted and sustained.
* Document repeatable manufacturing and supply chain practices, lessons learned, and standard processes; support their application across other Blue Bird operations as assigned.

 

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES FOR SUCCESS**

* Strong knowledge of manufacturing launch, capital projects, equipment installation, process validation, quality readiness, workforce planning, and production ramp execution.
* Practical expertise in PFEP, material flow design, inventory management, replenishment systems, and integration of materials processes with production requirements.
* Ability to apply Lean and CI methods to solve operational problems and sustain measurable results.
* Ability to lead through influence, secure cross-functional commitments, resolve competing priorities, and escalate issues with clear recommendations.
* Strong planning, documentation, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to personally build and maintain detailed schedules, trackers, and performance reports.
* Ability to move between leadership discussions and detailed work on the production floor, adapting to changing requirements while maintaining accountability for results.

 

**BASIC EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of project management, manufacturing launch, industrialization, operations, plant engineering, or production readiness experience.
* 8+ years demonstrated experience implementing PFEP or comparable part-level materials planning systems and leading Lean, CI, or operational excellence initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* All candidates must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility at the time of hire.

 

**WE VALUE**

* Ability to anticipate and understand customer needs and provide guidance
* Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills to handle difficult and sensitive matters.
* Strong project management skills. Exposure to difficult or complex projects a plus.
* Ability to influence stakeholders
* Effective communication and ability to communicate complex details in a clear manner.
* Flexible workspaces and work hours to help you unleash the best you.
* Working in a collaborative team and balancing the needs of individual stakeholders while delivering corporate objectives.

 

**INCLUDES**

* Continued Professional Development
* Benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 14 paid holidays, vacation time and 401k matching

 

**WORK CONDITIONS**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Office environment and production environment
* Must work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to heat, cold and noise
* Fast-paced production area with moving objects and sheet metal
* Occasional periods of standing or sitting for extended periods of time
* You must wear appropriate PPE when and where required
* Frequent weeks working 40+ hours
* Frequent communication with people throughout the day

 

* The specific statements shown in each section of this description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria necessary to successfully perform the job. protected_roles.description:
The Plant Manager will oversee all operations at the Atlanta Plant, ensuring that production goals are met while maintaining high standards of quality and safety. This role is crucial in driving efficiency and productivity, as well as fostering a positive work environment for all employees. The Plant Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing strategic plans that align with the company's objectives, while also managing budgets and resources effectively. Additionally, this position will involve collaborating with various departments to optimize processes and address any operational challenges. Ultimately, the Plant Manager will play a key role in enhancing the plant's performance and contributing to the overall success of the organization.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience in a laundry processing facility, with a minimum of 3 years in a management role.
* Strong understanding of production processes, quality control, and safety regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies.
* Proven track record of successfully managing large teams and complex projects.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage daily operations of the plant, ensuring production targets are met.
* Develop and implement operational strategies to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and quality standards throughout the facility.
* Manage and mentor plant staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and teamwork.
* Analyze production data and metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.

**Skills:**

The required skills for this role include strong leadership and communication abilities, which are essential for managing a diverse team and ensuring effective collaboration across departments. Analytical skills are crucial for interpreting production data and making informed decisions that drive operational improvements. Problem-solving skills will be utilized daily to address challenges that arise in the production process, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. Additionally, knowledge of safety regulations and quality standards will be applied to maintain compliance and uphold the plant's reputation. Preferred skills, such as experience with Lean Manufacturing, will enhance the ability to implement efficient processes and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Senior Manager, Plant/Site and contribute to global science and healthcare. You'll oversee operations at advanced facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. This leadership role involves advancing operational excellence through Lean manufacturing principles, managing cross-functional teams, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
As the site leader, you'll be responsible for developing and executing strategic plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining strong customer relationships. You'll support our core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement while cultivating a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence. This role offers the opportunity to implement positive change, support team development, and contribute to scientific advances. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in sophisticated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Science, Business Management, or related field
* Strong track record implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Experience leading teams in FDA-regulated, cGMP, ISO 13485, or similar quality systems
* Demonstrated financial acumen in budget management and operational cost control
* Excellence in developing and executing strategic and annual operating plans
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams in matrix organizations
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
* Experience with quality systems, regulatory compliance, and audit management
* Expert knowledge of operational KPIs and data-driven process improvement
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels

* Proficiency in leading change management initiatives

* Experience of working in a unionized environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to travel up to 10-15% as required
* Experience maintaining safety programs and environmental compliance
* Excellent vendor and customer relationship management skills

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Connecticut is $131,300.00–$205,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

protected_roles.title: Plant Manager
protected_roles.description:
Permian Enterprises Ltd. is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Plant Manager** to oversee daily plant operations and lead our production team. The Plant Manager is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting production goals, maintaining quality standards, and delivering excellent customer service.

This individual will provide strong leadership, establish operational priorities, develop employees, and ensure all plant activities align with company policies, procedures, and performance expectations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong decision-making skills, a commitment to workplace safety, and the ability to build a productive, accountable, and positive team culture.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Oversee and coordinate all daily plant operations to ensure production goals and deadlines are consistently met.
* Establish production schedules, determine priorities, and allocate resources to maximize operational efficiency.
* Monitor production performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions to increase productivity.
* Ensure all work is completed in accordance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and company procedures.
* Coordinate activities across departments and multiple operational entities to maintain smooth and efficient workflows.
* Manage equipment, materials, labor, and other resources effectively.

**Leadership & Employee Management**

* Provide direction, supervision, and support to plant employees and supervisory personnel.
* Assign responsibilities, delegate tasks, and establish clear performance expectations.
* Hold employees accountable for performance, attendance, productivity, and adherence to company policies.
* Address employee concerns and workplace issues professionally, consistently, and in a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain a positive workplace culture built on teamwork, communication, respect, and accountability.
* Identify training needs and support employee development and growth.

**Safety & Quality Control**

* Promote a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with all company safety policies and procedures.
* Ensure employees are properly trained and follow required safety practices.
* Monitor quality control processes to ensure products and services meet company and customer expectations.
* Identify operational risks, address safety concerns, and take corrective action when necessary.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and professional plant environment.

**Communication & Performance**

* Communicate effectively with upper management, supervisors, employees, and customers as needed.
* Provide regular updates regarding production performance, staffing, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities.
* Make timely decisions and resolve operational issues with sound judgment.
* Balance multiple priorities while maintaining focus on company objectives and deadlines.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of **2 years of management experience** in an oilfield plant or production plant environment preferred.
* Experience with coating and sandblasting operations preferred.
* Strong leadership and employee management skills, with demonstrated experience handling employee relations and maintaining a positive workplace culture.
* Excellent critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to interpret complex situations and communicate expectations and solutions effectively.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and delegate responsibilities.
* Self-motivated, dependable, and capable of working independently with limited oversight.
* Proficient in English, including reading and writing.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
* Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record required.

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Salary:** Up to $115,000 per year, based on qualifications and experience.

**Required Experience**

* Production Plant Management: Minimum 2 years
* Oilfield Management: Minimum 2 years

**Language**

* English: Required
* Spanish: Preferred

**Work Environment**

* Full-time, in-person position.
* Requires a hands-on leadership presence within the plant and the ability to oversee daily operational activities.

**Permian Enterprises Ltd. is committed to maintaining a safe, productive, and respectful workplace while delivering quality service to our customers.**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Description:

Davis Furniture is a family-owned high-end furniture manufacturer who is a leader in contemporary contract furniture. We have been in business for over 80 years, and we put a strong focus on new product introductions because design is a choice. Business at Davis is thriving! We are currently looking to hire a new Plant Manager for one of our plants.

Requirements:

The Plant Manager is the primary resource for all plant functions in area of responsibility. Manages both supervisors and hourly employees; and interacts with support personnel to ensure all established key metrics are achieved. Responsible for ensuring all company policy and procedures are followed, driving continuous improvement initiatives, enforcing safety policies and procedures, and ensuring that quality is maintained to Davis and customer standards.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee all manufacturing processes
* Ensure production schedules, output goals, and quality standards are consistently met
* Monitor workflow, labor utilization, and process efficiency
* Identify and resolve production issues while driving continuous improvement initiatives
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors and department managers
* Manage hiring, training, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and engagement
* Enforce safety policies and ensure OSHA compliance
* Lead safety initiatives to reduce workplace incidents
* Ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements
* Manage labor, materials, and operational costs
* Track and analyze key performance metrics (efficiency, scrap, downtime, throughput)
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and improve overall plant performance
* Oversee preventative maintenance and equipment reliability
* Coordinate repairs and capital improvements
* Partner with purchasing and planning to maintain proper inventory levels and ensure material availability
* Other duties may be added as required\*

**Education/Experience**

* Must be 18 years of age
* Associate's or Bachelor's in Operations Management, Industrial Technology, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of five years of manufacturing leadership experience, preferably in furniture, upholstery, textile, or related manufacturing environments.
* Previous experience managing sewing, cutting, upholstery, or similar production operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supervisors and production employees.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, production scheduling, labor management, and quality control.
* Understanding of fabric handling, cutting methods, patterns, sewing operations, and material utilization.
* Experience with production metrics, cost management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to make operational decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Weekly pay

401(k)

Profit Sharing

Excellent health insurance with low deductible

Dental and vision plans

Voluntary and Company paid Life insurance

Short term/Long-term disability

Referral program

protected_roles.title: Printing Plant Manager
protected_roles.description:
**Work Location: Newington, CT. This is an in person role, not remote, not hybrid**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Work Schedule: Monday - Friday; 8:30 am - 5:00 pm**

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, management, and performance of the Data-Graphics manufacturing facility. This position directs all aspects of plant operations, including production, quality, safety, maintenance, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Plant Manager ensures production commitments are met while maintaining high quality standards, maximizing operational efficiency, controlling costs, and fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and safety.

The Plant Manager provides strategic and hands-on leadership to achieve key performance indicators (KPIs), customer satisfaction goals, employee engagement objectives, and business growth initiatives.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
=========================================

**Operations Management**

* Direct and oversee all day-to-day plant operations, including production, scheduling, quality, safety, maintenance and receiving activities.
* Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining quality standards, delivery commitments, and operational efficiency.
* Develop, monitor, and achieve plant performance metrics related to productivity, quality, waste reduction, safety, downtime, labor utilization, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with sales, customer service, prepress, and production teams to ensure customer expectations are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establish priorities and allocate resources to support production requirements and business objectives.
* Analyze operational performance and implement corrective actions as needed to improve productivity and profitability.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, and production personnel to maximize performance and engagement.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, teamwork, professionalism, and employee development.
* Conduct performance evaluations, establish performance expectations, and provide ongoing coaching and feedback.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee relations matters, recruitment, retention, performance management, and disciplinary actions.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate training and development opportunities to support operational excellence.

**Quality Management**

* Champion quality initiatives to ensure products consistently meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
* Investigate quality concerns and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Monitor production processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and defect reduction.
* Work closely with client services and suppliers to address quality-related concerns and maintain strong business relationships.

**Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all company safety policies, environmental regulations, and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Promote and maintain a safe work environment through training, audits, inspections, and corrective actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and support accident investigation and root cause analysis activities.
* Ensure appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is utilized and safety procedures are consistently followed.

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee preventive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, waste reduction, and cost-saving initiatives throughout the facility.
* Evaluate equipment, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for increased efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve throughput, reduce spoilage, and optimize labor utilization.

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operational expenses.
* Monitor labor costs, production costs, and capital expenditures to ensure financial targets are achieved.
* Participate in forecasting, strategic planning, and capital investment decisions affecting the facility.

**Communication & Reporting**

* Communicate operational results, goals, and key initiatives to leadership and employees.
* Prepare and present reports on plant performance, production metrics, quality trends, safety performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Keep executive management informed of significant operational issues, risks, and opportunities.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of company objectives.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience overseeing production operations and employees.
* Printing, packaging, direct mail, graphic communications, or related manufacturing industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.
* Experience managing budgets, KPIs, production planning, and quality systems.

**COMPETENCIES**

**Leadership**

* Strong leadership and team-building abilities
* Ability to motivate and develop employees at all levels
* Effective coaching, mentoring, and performance management skills
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities

**Operational Excellence**

* Knowledge of manufacturing operations and process improvement methodologies
* Understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles
* Experience utilizing production metrics and KPIs to drive results
* Strong project management and organizational skills

**Technical Knowledge**

* Knowledge of printing operations, lithographic printing, flexographic printing, finishing, and mailing operations preferred
* Understanding of quality management systems and root cause analysis techniques
* Knowledge of maintenance planning and equipment reliability principles

**Communication & Business Skills**

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong analytical and financial acumen
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook
* Ability to effectively manage customer, vendor, and employee relationships

The plant manager is responsible to operate the Pacific Plant consistent with company goals for cost, quality, service, regulatory compliance, safety, labor relations, and housekeeping. Function as a consultant for other plants and corporate.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze Daily, Weekly, and Monthly performance data (cost, production, quality, safety, service, and human relations) and work with department heads to optimize plant performance.
* Spend time in the plant reviewing the operation, speaking with associates, answering questions, soliciting for improvement ideas, reinforcing policy and procedures, etc.
* Train and coach department heads and Supervisors in problem solving, priority setting, goal setting, Confrontation/Communication skills, Labor Relations, etc.
* Complete required reports for Corporate, State and Federal agencies. Maintain PSM standards.
* Optimize safety performance, including daily tours through the plant, review of all accident reports, conducting safety meetings, one to one discussion with associates, review of safety infractions/discipline, and housekeeping tours.
* Collaborate with R&D and Marketing to assure manufacturing capabilities align with product innovation launches.
* Miscellaneous administrative work regarding phone calls, forecasting, audits, capital projects, wage proposals, collaboration meetings etc.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 7 years of experience managing a plant
* Very strong verbal communication skills, ability to effectively communicate one-on-one and present to large group.
* Strong written communication skills: ability to effectively communicate with customers by email, as well as develop written reports and presentations.
* High proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, SAP experience is a plus.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and analytical skills
* Experienced in Project Management and statistics.
Familiarity with DAP products a plus 

**About DAP**

DAP is a market leading manufacturer, innovator and marketer of home repair and construction products including caulks, sealants, spray foam insulation, adhesives, and patch and repair products. DAP is part of RPM International Inc., a $7.3 billion, multinational company with subsidiaries that are world leaders in specialty coatings, sealants, building materials and related services.

You will find DAP products in the hands of professional painters, remodelers, builders, and do-it-yourselfers, and in 60,000 retail outlets, ranging from home centers and mass merchandisers to your local hardware, pro contractor channels and paint stores. DAP's eight manufacturing and distribution facilities in the United States of America and Canada service North America and the world.

At DAP, we hire the best people and give them a collaborative and rewarding work environment that empowers them to succeed! We support associates in continuous professional growth and collaborate on the steps it takes to get to the next level in their careers. Our associates enjoy a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k) with company match, pension, paid parental leave, competitive health insurance rates, employee stock purchase plan, tuition reimbursement, free wellness programs and more! **Job Overview**
----------------

The Senior Manufacturing Engineering Manager is responsible for overseeing and leading a team of engineers to deliver technical projects efficiently and effectively. This role involves managing resources, budgets, and project timelines, ensuring high-quality engineering solutions, and providing technical guidance. The Senior Manufacturing Engineering Manager is responsible for team development, stakeholder communication and implementing best practices to achieve project goals and drive innovation. 
#LI-BB2

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

Serving in a leadership role, directly supervising project engineers and designers.

Overseeing, managing, and supporting calibration programs for the facilities, including production equipment, facility equipment.

Developing concepts for new and revised products maximizing function, safety, features, and user benefits while minimizing costs.

Directing preparation of models and lab testing as required to develop product.

Preparing and maintaining Project Control Charts and schedules.

Participating in meetings as required to communicate and coordinate projects with various departments within Hubbell.

Developing the site maintenance budget for approval and managing site budget costs to meet the approved budget targets.

Directing preparation of product drawings and checking completed drawings.

Preparing product standards and specifications and obtaining agency listings as required (UL/CSA etc.).

Approving tooling, assemblies, and updating drawings. Release approved product for production.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (required)

10+ years of relevant experience (required)

5+ supervisory experience in an engineering related field (required)

Ability to check design drawings with extreme thoroughness while paying strict attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple design projects with varying priority levels

Proven track record working with systems engineering functions including concept of operations development, requirements management, technical risk management, interface definition and control

Experience effectively communicating and presenting with all levels of management and individual contributors on the program team

Strong organization, coordination, planning and collaboration skills

Experience supporting engineering teams in a multi-discipline environment

Experience conducting system integration and system tests to include development of integration and test plans, test cases and procedures

Ability to visualize system functionality, to create block diagrams, and to analyze system performance

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

protected_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Flight Coordination Quality & Tr
protected_roles.description:
**Title Options:** Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager

**Location:** Remote, US

**Reports to:** VP of Flight Coordination

**Hours:** Monday – Friday 8:30 am – 5:30 pm

**Position Summary**

The **Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager** represents a quality-control and workforce-development function similar to those found in high-performing contact centers and service-delivery organizations. The role ensures every incoming lead, whether received by phone, web form, chat, or referral, is responded to promptly, handled consistently, accurately qualified, fully documented, and advanced through the appropriate next step. Through quality assurance, coaching, training, performance analytics, workflow oversight, and cross-functional coordination, this role strengthens Flight Coordinator performance while protecting the patient and partner experience from first contact through flight execution

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for continuously reviewing lead interactions, identifying performance and process gaps, and translating findings into targeted coaching, training, and development initiatives. The individual reviews call recordings, chats, web submissions, referral activity, CRM records, follow-up activity, and department handoffs to identify quality risks before they affect a patient, referring facility, payer, partner, or flight outcome.

**How this role impacts our mission**

Every day, families, healthcare providers, and case managers rely on our team to help navigate complex situations and coordinate critical air medical transportation. As the nation's largest fixed-wing air ambulance operator, our mission is to make those moments easier through compassionate, expert air medical transportation, connecting patients with the care they need and getting them to that destination.

The Flight Coordination team is often the first point of contact, serving as a trusted guide through a time-sensitive and highly emotional process. As the FC Quality & Training Manager, you will strengthen team performance through coaching, training, quality oversight, and continuous improvement – helping Flight Coordinators build the skills and confidence to deliver compassionate, accurate, and professional service while advancing opportunities efficiently and supporting patients throughout their journey.

This is an opportunity to shape the experience of both our team members and the families we serve. By improving quality, readiness, and operational consistency, you will help ensure that every patient, provider, and referral partner receives the highest level of care and support throughout their journey.

**Core ownership**

Own quality control across every inbound lead channel and protect forward movement through two distinct stages: (1) incoming lead to qualified opportunity and (2) active opportunity to completed flight or a fully documented, supportable lost outcome.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**1. Intake Quality & Opportunity Readiness**

* Monitor incoming inquiry channels, queues, assignment, and response times to ensure every viable inquiry is acknowledged and actively worked within established service expectations.
* Review calls and transcripts for discovery, active listening, empathy, urgency recognition, value communication, objection handling, qualification, closing language, and clear next steps.
* Audit whether Flight Coordinators appropriately advance, nurture, close, or disqualify inquiries.

* Review inquiries marked false, invalid, duplicate, unqualified, or closed-lost. Challenge, reopen, or escalate records when the disposition is unsupported or a viable opportunity may have been missed.
* Identify conversion and process gaps by coordinator, source, payer type, referral source, service type, call scenario, shift, and funnel stage.
* Maintain a standardized intake-quality scorecard and documented expectations for what strong performance looks like.

**2. Flight Readiness & Coordination Oversight**

* Serves as a cross-departmental liaison with Clinical Operations and Revenue Cycle Management to confirm required clinical reviews, financial clearance, authorizations, documentation, and follow-through are progressing on time and that each opportunity is fully prepared to fly.
* Monitor active opportunities until they become completed flights or reach a documented and supportable lost outcome.
* Confirm each opportunity has a clear next action, responsible owner, due date, and follow-up plan.
* Audit records for required patient, clinical, financial, facility, authorization, payer, transportation, logistics, and operational information.
* Identify aging, stalled, inactive, or incomplete opportunities and intervene before the flight is delayed or lost.
* Ensure follow-up continues after an inquiry is advanced to an opportunity and that ownership does not stop at the initial commitment.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.

**Quality Review, Coaching & Development**

* Establish and maintain a consistent review methodology across inbound calls, outbound follow-up, quote conversations, high-urgency inquiries, lost-flight interactions, and other priority scenarios.
* Conduct recurring one-on-one coaching using specific examples from calls, transcripts, records, and workflow activity.
* Create documented coaching plans with clear behaviors, actions, due dates, and follow-up review.
* Recognize strong performance and share repeatable best practices across the team.
* Measure whether coaching produces sustained improvement and escalate recurring quality or workflow concerns to Flight Coordination leadership.
* Partner with leaders on focused development plans when additional support or accountability is needed.

**4. Training & Team Readiness**

* Translate quality findings into targeted training, refreshers, job aids, talk tracks, checklists, and scenario-based exercises.

* Identify recurring themes that require team-wide training rather than individual coaching.
* Coordinate subject-matter input from Revenue Cycle Management, Clinical Operations, Logistics, and other operational partners.
* Maintain current process guidance and a centralized source of truth for Flight Coordination expectations.
* Support new-hire onboarding, readiness reviews, and ongoing proficiency checks.
* Track training completion, understanding, and sustained application on the job.

**5. Cross-Functional Handoff Quality**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Flight Coordination and departments receiving or supporting active opportunities.
* Establish clear handoff reuirements, ownership expectations, and acceptance criteria with partner departments.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.

**SENIOR MANAGER, QUALITY IMPROVEMENT**

**What you’ll do.**

As the Senior Manager, Quality Improvement, you’ll help neurologists put evidence into practice by managing the processes that support clinical practice guidelines, evidence-based publications, and resources. You’ll advance the AAN’s strategic objectives by supporting the development of timely, evidence-based clinical guidelines, editorial and dissemination strategies, and meaningful resources that engage neurologists in improving their practice. Working across divisions, you’ll connect clinical practice and quality efforts to deliver value for AAN members.

**Please review the attached job description for full details. If viewing from an external site, please visit** **https://www.aan.com/about-the-aan/work-at-the-aan****.**

**Who we are.**

Join a diverse community of fun, energetic, and dedicated employees and members who are committed to supporting neurologists worldwide in providing exceptional care to their patients. We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Plant Manager to lead our operations at our facility in Canton, OH, 44720. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of innovation within the plant.

protected_roles.title: Plant Manager- tissue and paper manufacturing
protected_roles.description:
This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a proven manufacturing executive with deep **paper manufacturing and paper machine operations experience**. Our client is seeking a hands-on, results-driven leader who can take full ownership of plant performance, strengthen operational discipline, and lead the facility to improved results across **safety, quality, production, reliability, cost and people development**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for all aspects of plant operations and will play a key role in driving performance improvements, stabilizing underperforming areas, and building a strong culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This role is ideal for a seasoned Plant Manager or senior operations leader who understands the complexity of paper manufacturing and has a track record of improving plant performance through strong leadership, technical knowledge, disciplined execution and data-driven decision-making.

The Plant Manager will oversee the day-to-day and strategic leadership of the facility, ensuring the plant operates safely, efficiently and profitably while developing both leadership and frontline teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve established **safety, quality, production, reliability and financial objectives**.
* Build and reinforce a strong **safety culture** through visible leadership, clear expectations, coaching and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Oversee plant performance and ensure operations are aligned with productivity, quality and cost targets.
* Optimize **paper machine performance**, equipment uptime, production output and finished-product quality.
* Improve equipment reliability through strong maintenance systems, including preventive and predictive maintenance, planning and scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Manage and improve plant financial performance, including cost-per-ton, labour, maintenance, fibre, chemical and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts using structured, data-driven problem-solving methodologies to improve operational and financial results.
* Develop and execute recovery or turnaround plans for underperforming operations, establishing clear priorities, ownership, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Build, coach and strengthen plant leadership, technical and hourly teams through employee development, performance management, succession planning and accountability.
* Partner with maintenance, production, quality and leadership teams to ensure cross-functional alignment and effective execution of plant priorities.
* Establish a culture focused on **performance, engagement, ownership and continuous improvement**.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a strong plant leader with deep technical and operational knowledge of **paper manufacturing**, particularly **paper machine operations**, who can lead a large team and drive measurable business results.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing** or a related field is preferred.
* 10–15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* **Must have direct paper manufacturing experience**, including demonstrated technical knowledge of **paper machine operations**.
* Proven experience leading paper machine operations and delivering sustainable improvements in performance, reliability and quality.
* Demonstrated success improving underperforming facilities or leading plant turnaround/recovery initiatives.
* Strong understanding of **papermaking processes, maintenance and reliability systems, plant operations and financial management**.
* Experience managing key manufacturing metrics, including productivity, equipment uptime, cost control and quality performance.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, develop talent, drive accountability and guide organizational change effectively.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence performance at all levels of the plant.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Enter your email
* Available time for call

Experience:

* tissue and paper manufacturing operation: 10 years (Required)

Work Location: On the road

**Role Description:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the management, planning, and coordination of all precast manufacturing operations to meet DVP business goals, while providing leadership to all plant and yard personnel.

**General Supervisory Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Create and manage production schedules based on manpower, customer demand, and DVP business goals
* Meet with General Manager as needed to review any safety concerns, production & quality issues, personnel needs, and inventory levels
* Conducts daily supervisor meetings to discuss production schedules, concerns, opportunities for improvement and to ensure ongoing organizational teamwork
* Hold monthly plant safety meetings and review any safety related deficiencies and submit recommendations to DVP senior management
* Track key performance metrics and hold direct reports accountable for results
* Ensure all production and yard operations meet DVP quality control standards
* Track and manage the inventory levels of finished goods
* Oversee and manage all incoming materials to ensure adequate inventory levels are met
* Continually collect and review data to reduce inefficiencies and waste
* Successfully hire, supervise, train, and retain production/yard staff
* Evaluate and review employee’s performance for the purpose of determining skill level and training needs
* Coach and mentor employees to allow for increased responsibilities and career advancement. Lead by example.
* Promote and maintain a clean work environment
* Recommend purchases of additional equipment for efficiency, cost reductions and/or quality improvements
* Successfully work with Quality Control/Project Management to meet customer demand and expectations
* Perform any other duties as assigned by the General Manager

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Supervision of Plant Supervisors
* Leading by example, create and sustain a safe working environment for the facility

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Eligible to work in the U.S
* Successful experience in precast plant management
* Ability to read contract documents, engineering specifications and drawings
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Excellent time management skills
* Highly organized and self-motivated
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Work with computer as necessary (Microsoft Word, Excel)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Standing and walking for extended periods of time
* Exposure to fluctuating weather conditions including extreme cold or heat
* Must be in good physical and mental health

**Education and Experience:**

* 10+ years of precast concrete experience
* 5+ years production supervision or related experience

**Pay Range:** Commensurate with experience

protected_roles.description:
Description:

**Plant Manager** 
**Location:** United Rolls Inc. In Canton, Ohio 
**Department:** Operations 
**Reports To:** President 
**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Position Summary**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, safety, quality, and profitability of United Rolls Inc.'s manufacturing operations, including an iron foundry and machine shop specializing in the production of centrifugal spun cast iron rolls for the steel, aluminum, paper, plastics, and other industrial processing industries. This position directs all aspects of production, maintenance, quality assurance, engineering, environmental compliance, and workforce development to ensure on-time delivery of world-class products while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Safety and Environmental Leadership**

* Establish and maintain a strong safety culture throughout the foundry and machine shop operations.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, state environmental regulations, and company safety policies.
* Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and safety training programs.
* Drive continuous improvement in safety metrics, including reduction of recordable incidents and near misses.

**Operations Management**

* Direct daily operations of the iron foundry, centrifugal casting processes, heat treatment operations, roll finishing, and machine shop activities.
* Ensure production schedules meet customer delivery requirements while maintaining efficiency and quality standards.
* Monitor plant productivity, capacity utilization, scrap rates, and operational performance metrics.
* Coordinate production planning, workflow optimization, and resource allocation.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Foundry Management**

* Oversee all foundry operations including:
* Melting and pouring of iron alloys.
* Centrifugal casting of rolls.
* Mold preparation and handling.
* Heat treatment processes.
* Metallurgical testing and quality control.
* Ensure proper process controls are maintained to achieve customer specifications and metallurgical requirements.
* Drive improvements in yield, casting quality, and process consistency.

**Machine Shop Leadership**

* Manage machining operations involving large CNC and manual equipment used in roll finishing.
* Optimize machine utilization, tooling performance, setup reduction, and throughput.
* Ensure proper maintenance and calibration of machine tools and inspection equipment.
* Support implementation of advanced machining technologies and automation where appropriate.

**Quality Assurance**

* Partner with Quality and Metallurgical teams to ensure product integrity.
* Lead efforts to reduce defects, rework, customer complaints, and warranty claims.
* Ensure compliance with ISO and customer quality standards.
* Review and analyze quality metrics and implement corrective actions.

**Maintenance and Reliability**

* Direct preventive and predictive maintenance programs for foundry and machining equipment.
* Develop capital improvement and equipment replacement plans.
* Minimize downtime through effective maintenance planning and reliability strategies.
* Oversee utilities, plant infrastructure, and critical support systems.

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage annual operating budgets.
* Monitor labor, material, energy, maintenance, and overhead costs.
* Identify and implement cost reduction initiatives.
* Analyze production and operational data to maximize profitability.
* Support capital investment planning and ROI analysis.

**Leadership and Workforce Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, managers, and hourly employees.
* Foster employee engagement, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Support workforce planning, succession planning, and talent development efforts.
* Collaborate with Human Resources on hiring, performance management, and employee relations.
* Maintain positive labor-management relationships where applicable.

**Customer and Business Support**

* Support sales and customer service teams by ensuring manufacturing capabilities align with customer requirements.
* Participate in customer visits, audits, and technical reviews.
* Work closely with engineering on new product development and process improvements.
* Maintain strong communication with suppliers and contractors.

**Position Impact**

The Plant Manager plays a critical leadership role in ensuring United Rolls Inc. delivers high-quality spun cast iron rolls safely, efficiently, and profitably while driving continuous improvement and supporting the company's long-term growth objectives.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Metallurgy, Industrial Management, or related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and industry experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years in a plant management, operations management, or senior production leadership role.
* Strong experience in foundry operations, metal casting, steel or iron manufacturing, heavy industrial manufacturing, or related industries.
* Experience managing machining operations and large CNC equipment preferred.
* Proven success leading safety, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Iron metallurgy and centrifugal casting processes.
* Foundry operations and heat treatment processes.
* CNC machining and machining best practices.
* Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Quality management systems and root cause analysis.
* Maintenance and reliability management.
* ERP/MRP manufacturing systems.
* OSHA and environmental compliance standards.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* High level of accountability and integrity.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* OSHA Recordable Incident Rate
* Lost Time Accident Rate
* On-Time Delivery Performance
* Production Throughput
* Scrap and Yield Performance
* Cost Per Ton Produced
* Machine Utilization
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
* Customer Quality Performance
* Employee Retention and Engagement
* Maintenance Downtime
* EBITDA/Operating Profit Contribution

**Physical and Work Environment Requirements**

* Frequent presence in foundry and machine shop environments.
* Exposure to heat, noise, dust, moving equipment, and industrial hazards.
* Ability to walk production areas daily and occasionally climb stairs, ladders, and platforms.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
